msgid: {PLAYER} received a TOWN MAP\nfrom DAISY.
msgstr: {PLAYER} reçoit la\nCarte!

msgid: You don't have space for this in\nyour BAG.
msgstr: Ton inventaire est plein.

msgid: You can use the TOWN MAP to find\nout where you are, or check the\lnames of places.
msgstr: Utilise la Carte pour connaître ta\nposition.

msgid: DAISY: Just like people, POKéMON\nare living things.\pWhen they get tired, please give\nthem a rest.
msgstr: Nina: Comme les gens, les Pokémon\nsont des êtres vivants.\pIls doivent aussi se reposer quand\nils sont fatigués.

msgid: It's a big map of the KANTO region.\nNow this would be useful!
msgstr: C’est une carte!\nÇa peut être utile!

msgid: The shelves are crammed full of\nbooks on POKéMON.
msgstr: Des bouquins sur les Pokémon!

msgid: You don't need any grooming done?\nOkay, we'll just have tea.
msgstr: Nina: Tu ne veux pas que je m’en\noccupe?\lOK. Un peu de thé, alors…

msgid: Which one should I groom?
msgstr: Nina: Lequel dois-je bichonner?
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Lequel veux-tu me confier?

msgid: DAISY: Okay, I'll get it looking\nnice in no time.
msgstr: Nina: OK, je vais le faire beau en\ndeux secondes.

msgid: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't\ngroom an EGG.
msgstr: Nina: Oh, désolée. Je ne peux pas\nm’occuper d’un Œuf.
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Huhuhu…\nJe ne peux pas m’occuper d’un Oeuf!

msgid: DAISY: Your POKéMON grow to love\nyou if you raise them with love.\pFor example, {PLAYER}, may I see\nyour first POKéMON?
msgstr: Nina: Tes Pokémon te le rendront\nbien si tu les élèves avec amour.\pPar exemple, {PLAYER}, je peux\nvoir ton premier Pokémon?

msgid: It couldn't possibly love you\nany more than it does now.\pYour POKéMON is happy beyond\nwords.
msgstr: Il ne pourrait pas t’aimer plus\nque maintenant.\pTon Pokémon est vraiment\nheureux avec toi.

msgid: It looks very happy.\pI wish {RIVAL} could see this and\nlearn something from it.
msgstr: Il a l’air heureux.\pSi seulement {RIVAL} pouvait voir\nça et en tirer des leçons.

msgid: It's quite friendly with you.\nKeep being good to it!
msgstr: Il t’aime bien. Continue\ncomme ça!

msgid: It's warming up to you.\nTrust must be growing between you.
msgstr: Il commence à s’attacher à toi.\pLa confiance va s’instaurer entre\nvous deux.

msgid: It's not quite familiar with you\nyet.\pPOKéMON are all quite wary when\nyou first get them.
msgstr: Il n’est pas encore habitué à toi.\pLes Pokémon sont toujours\nun peu craintifs au début.

msgid: {PLAYER}, I don't like the way it\nglares at you.\pCould you try being a little nicer\nto it?
msgstr: {PLAYER}, je n’aime pas beaucoup\nla façon dont il te regarde.\pTu devrais être un peu plus\nsympa avec.

msgid: …Um, it's not easy for me to say\nthis, but…\pIs there some reason why your\nPOKéMON would hate you so much?
msgstr: … Ça me fait mal au cœur\nde dire ça, mais…\pY’a-t-il une raison pour laquelle\nil te déteste tant?

msgid: “The lovely and sweet\nCLEFAIRY”
msgstr: Le gentil et adorable MELOFEE.

msgid:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.\pI had this weird dream about
a DROWZEE eating my dream.\pAnd…
I learned how to eat dreams…\pOogh, this is too spooky!\pLet me teach it to a POKéMON so
I can forget about it!
msgstr:
(Bâiiiille)
J’ai dû m’endormir au soleil.\pJ’ai rêvé qu’un SOPORIFIK
dévorait mes rêves…\pEt j’ai appris comment
dévorer les rêves…\pC’est dingue ça!\pLaisse-moi l’apprendre aussi
à un Pokémon.

msgid: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nDREAM EATER?
msgstr: A quel Pokémon enseigner\nDévorêve?

msgid: …ZZZ…\nI…can't eat…anymore…
msgstr: … Zzz… Peux…\nplus… rien… manger…

msgid: CLEFAIRY came from the moon.\nThat's what the rumor is.\pThey appeared after MOON STONES\nfell on MT. MOON.
msgstr: On raconte que les MELOFEE sont\ndes habitants de la lune!\pIls sont apparus après la chute\nde la Pierre Lune sur le Mont\lSélénite.

msgid:
There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.
msgstr:
Il n’y a pas vraiment de
Dresseurs sérieux par ici.\pIls s’intéressent surtout aux
Insectes, rien de passionnant.\pMais Pierre d’Argenta n’est
pas comme ça, pas du tout.

msgid: Did you check out the MUSEUM?
msgstr: T’as déjà visité le Musée?

msgid: Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON\namazing?
msgstr: Les fossiles du Mont Sélénite sont\nintéressants, hein?

msgid: Really?\nYou absolutely have to go!
msgstr: Non?\nMais il faut y aller, voyons!

msgid: This is it, the MUSEUM.\pYou have to pay to get in, but it's\nworth it. See you around!
msgstr: C’est par là! L’entrée est\npayante mais ça vaut l’coup!

msgid: Psssst!\nDo you know what I'm doing?
msgstr: Psssst!\nTu sais c’que j’fais?

msgid: That's right!\nIt's hard work!
msgstr: Ah bon?\nOK.

msgid: I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild\nPOKéMON out of my garden!
msgstr: Je vaporise du Repousse\npour éloigner les Pokémon\pde mon jardin!

msgid: You're a TRAINER, right?\pBROCK's looking for new\nchallengers. Follow me!
msgstr: T’es Dresseur?\pPierre cherche un adversaire!\nSuis-moi!

msgid: If you have the right stuff,\ngo take on BROCK!
msgstr: Si tu t’en sens capable, tu devrais\naller affronter Pierre!

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON that appear in battle,\nhowever briefly, earn EXP Points.
msgstr: Astuce\pChaque Pokémon prenant part au\ncombat, même pendant une seconde,\pgagne des points Exp.

msgid: NOTICE!\pThieves have been stealing POKéMON\nfossils from MT. MOON.\pPlease call the PEWTER POLICE if\nyou have any information.
msgstr: Avis!\pOn nous signale des voleurs de\nfossiles de Pokémon au\pMont Sélénite.\pN’hésitez pas à contacter la\nPolice d’Argenta!

msgid: PEWTER CITY\nA Stone Gray City
msgstr: Argenta\nLe mat et le gris de la roche

msgid: I'm glad I caught up to you.\nI'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.\pI've been asked to deliver this,\nso here you go.
msgstr: Content de te voir. Je suis\nl’Assistant du Prof. Chen.\pOn m’a demandé de te donner\nça, alors voilà…

msgid: {PLAYER} received the\nRUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.
msgstr: {PLAYER} reçoit les Chaussures de\nSport de l’Assistant.

msgid: Press the B Button to run.\nBut only where there's room to run!
msgstr: Appuie sur le bouton B\npour courir.\pMais seulement où tu as la place\npour ça!

msgid: Well, I must be going back to\nthe LAB.\pBye-bye!
msgstr: Bon, je dois retourner au Labo.\pAu revoir.

msgid: There's a letter attached…\pDear {PLAYER},\pHere is a pair of RUNNING SHOES\nfor my beloved challenger.\pRemember, I'll always cheer for\nyou! Don't ever give up!\pFrom Mom
msgstr: Il y a un mot avec:\p{PLAYER},\pVoilà une paire de Chaussures\nde Sport mon petit bouchon.\pBon courage, \nta maman.

msgid:
So, you're here. I'm BROCK.
I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.\pMy rock-hard willpower is evident
even in my POKéMON.\pMy POKéMON are all rock hard, and
have true-grit determination.\pThat's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!\pFuhaha! You're going to challenge
me knowing that you'll lose?\pThat's the TRAINER's honor that
compels you to challenge me.\pFine, then!
Show me your best!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
msgstr:
Je suis Pierre! Je suis le
Champion d’Argenta!\pJe crois en la grande force de
la pierre!\pC’est pourquoi mes Pokémon sont
du type Roche!\pTu veux toujours te battre avec
moi? Même en sachant que\ltu vas perdre? \pTrès bien. En garde!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

msgid:
I took you for granted, and so
I lost.\pAs proof of your victory, I confer
on you this…the official POKéMON\lLEAGUE BOULDERBADGE.\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} received the BOULDERBADGE
from BROCK!{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\p{FONT_MALE}Just having the BOULDERBADGE makes
your POKéMON more powerful.\pIt also enables the use of the
move FLASH outside of battle.\pOf course, a POKéMON must know the
move FLASH to use it.
msgstr:
Hmm…
Beau combat. J’étais trop sûr de\lmoi, c’est pour ça que j’ai perdu.\pEn reconnaissance de ta victoire,
voici le Badge Roche!\p{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} reçoit le Badge Roche!
{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}\p{FONT_MALE}C’est un Badge officiel de la
Ligue Pokémon!\pLes Pokémon de son détenteur
deviennent plus puissants!\pLa technique Flash peut être
utilisée!

msgid: Wait!\nTake this with you.
msgstr: Attends!\nPrends ça avec toi!

msgid: {PLAYER} received TM39\nfrom BROCK.
msgstr: {PLAYER} reçoit la CT39!

msgid:
A TM, Technical Machine, contains a
technique for POKéMON.\pUsing a TM teaches the move it
contains to a POKéMON.\pA TM is good for only one use.\pSo, when you use one, pick the
POKéMON carefully.\pAnyways…
TM39 contains ROCK TOMB.\pIt hurls boulders at the foe and
lowers its SPEED.
msgstr:
Une CT (Capsule Tech.) contient
une attaque à enseigner à un\lPokémon!\pUne CT ne marche qu’une fois!\pAlors choisis bien le Pokémon à qui
la donner!\pLa CT39 contient Tomberoche!\pAvec cette capacité, ton Pokémon
lancera des rochers sur\pson ennemi pour baisser sa vitesse.

msgid:
There are all kinds of TRAINERS in
this huge world of ours.\pYou appear to be very gifted as a
POKéMON TRAINER.\pSo let me make a suggestion.\pGo to the GYM in CERULEAN and test
your abilities.
msgstr:
Il y a plusieurs types de
Dresseurs dans le monde!\pTu sembles être un Dresseur
d’exception!\pVa à l’Arène d’Azuria pour tester
tes capacités.

msgid: Stop right there, kid!\pYou're ten thousand light-years \nfrom facing BROCK!
msgstr: Une minute!\pTu es encore loin de pouvoir\nte battre contre Pierre.\pTu vas devoir m’affronter avant!

msgid: Darn!\pLight-years isn't time…\nIt measures distance!
msgstr: Zut!\pJ’aurais dû te laisser passer!

msgid: You're pretty hot.\n…But not as hot as BROCK!
msgstr: Tu sais te battre…\nMais pas aussi bien que Pierre!

msgid:
Hiya!
Do you want to dream big?\pDo you dare to dream of becoming
the POKéMON champ?\pI'm no TRAINER, but I can advise
you on how to win.\pLet me take you to the top!
msgstr: Salut graine de Champion!\pJe ne suis pas Dresseur mais\nmes conseils sont avisés!\pLaisse-moi te mener à la victoire!

msgid: All right!\nLet's get happening!
msgstr: OK!\nC’est parti!

msgid:
The first POKéMON out in a match is
at the left of the POKéMON LIST.\pBy changing the order of POKéMON,
you may gain an advantage.\pTry different orders to suit your
opponent's party.
msgstr:
Le 1er Pokémon apparaissant dans
un combat est celui à gauche dans\lla Liste Pokémon!\pEn changeant l’ordre des Pokémon,
tu peux changer de stratégie!\pEssaye différents ordres pour
t’adapter à ton adversaire.

msgid: It's a free service!\nLet's get happening!
msgstr: C’est gratuit, profites-en!

msgid: Just as I thought!\nYou're POKéMON champ material!
msgstr: Je le savais!\nTu as l’âme d’un Champion!

msgid: NIDORAN♂: Bowbow!
msgstr: Nidoran♂: Nidoni!

msgid: NIDORAN, sit!
msgstr: Nidoran, assis!

msgid:
Our POKéMON's an outsider, so it's
finicky and hard to handle.\pAn outsider is a POKéMON that you
get in a trade.\pIt grows fast, but it may ignore an
unskilled TRAINER in battle.\pIf only we had some BADGES…
msgstr:
Notre Pokémon est un échangé, il
est difficile à maîtriser.\pUn échangé est un Pokémon échangé
avec un autre joueur.\pIl grandit vite, mais il n’en fait
qu’à sa tête pendant les combats!\pSi seulement nous avions des
Badges…

msgid: POKéMON learn new techniques as\nthey grow.\pBut some moves must be taught to\nthem by people.
msgstr: Un Pokémon apprend des attaques\nen gagnant des niveaux!\pMais certaines attaques ne sont\nenseignées que par certaines\lpersonnes!

msgid:
A POKéMON becomes easier to 
catch if it has a status problem.\pSleep, poison, burn, or paralysis…
Those are all effective.\pBut catching POKéMON is never
a sure thing!
msgstr:
Les Pokémon sont plus faciles à
capturer s’ils ont un problème\lde statut!\pSommeil, poison, brûlure ou
paralysie sont très efficaces. \pMais attraper un Pokémon, c’est
jamais du tout cuit!

msgid: A shady old guy sucked me into\nbuying this weird fish POKéMON!\pIt's totally weak and it cost ¥500!
msgstr: Un vieil homme m’a vendu cet\nétrange poisson Pokémon!\pIl est super nul et il m’a coûté\n500¥!

msgid: Good things can happen if you raise\nPOKéMON diligently.\pEven the weak ones can surprise\nyou if you don't give up on them.
msgstr: Si tu élèves bien tes Pokémon,\nmême les plus faibles, il se\ppassera rien que des bonnes\nchoses!

msgid: Yes, yes.\nIt's ¥50 for a child's ticket.\pWould you like to come in?
msgstr: 50¥ le ticket pour un enfant.\pVoulez-vous entrer?

msgid: Right, ¥50!\nThank you!
msgstr: 50¥! Parfait!\nMerci!

msgid: You can't sneak in the back way!\nNice try, kid, but no.\pOh, whatever!\nDo you know what AMBER is?
msgstr: Ne te cache pas dans l’ombre!\pEnfin, si ça t’amuse! Au fait,\nsais-tu ce que c’est l’Ambre?

msgid: AMBER contains the genetic matter\nof ancient POKéMON.\pThere's a LAB somewhere trying to\nresurrect POKéMON from AMBER.
msgstr: Dans un certain labo, on essaie de\nrégénérer les anciens Pokémon\pgrâce à leur information génétique\ncontenue dans de l’Ambre.

msgid: AMBER is actually sap, that gooey\nstuff that oozes from trees.\pThe ancient sap fossilized over\ntime to become rock-hard AMBER.
msgstr: L’Ambre est en fait de la sève\ntombée des arbres.\pAvec le temps, la sève se\nfossilise pour devenir de l’Ambre.

msgid:
Ssh! Listen, I need to share a
secret with someone.\pI think that this chunk of AMBER
contains POKéMON DNA!\pIt would be a shattering scientific
breakthrough if POKéMON could be\lresurrected from it.\pBut, my colleagues just ignore
what I have to say.\pSo, I have a favor to ask!\pI want you to get this examined at
a POKéMON LAB somewhere.
msgstr:
Je crois qu’il y a des traces
d’ADN de Pokémon dans ce\lmorceau d’ambre.\pÇa serait une avancée scientifique
incroyable si on pouvait\prégénérer un Pokémon à partir de
cette pierre! Non? Hein?\pMais personne ne m’écoute!\pJ’ai une faveur à te demander!\pApporte ça à mon Labo Pokémon
pour l’examiner!

msgid: {PLAYER} received the OLD AMBER\nfrom the man.
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient le\nVieil Ambre!

msgid: Ssh!\nGet the OLD AMBER checked!
msgstr: Chut! Va faire examiner ce morceau\nd’Ambre!

msgid: You don't have space for this.
msgstr: Ton inventaire est plein!

msgid: We have two fossils of rare,\nprehistoric POKéMON on exhibit.
msgstr: Nous avons 2 fossiles dont nous\nsommes très fiers! Ce sont des\lPokémon préhistoriques!

msgid: There is a beautiful piece of\nAMBER in a clear gold color.
msgstr: Il y a un beau morceau d’Ambre\nd’un éclat doré!!

msgid: AERODACTYL Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.
msgstr: Fossile de PTERA\nUn Pokémon rare et ancien.

msgid: KABUTOPS Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.
msgstr: Fossile du KABUTOPS\nUn Pokémon rare et ancien.

msgid:
The secrets of space…
The mysteries of earth…\pThere are so many things about
which we know so little.\pBut that should spur us to study
harder, not toss in the towel.\pThe only thing you should toss…\pWell, how about SEISMIC TOSS?
Should I teach that to a POKéMON?
msgstr:
Les secrets de l’espace…
Les mystères de la terre…\pIl y a tant de choses que nous
ne comprenons pas encore.\pMais cela doit nous motiver à
apprendre davantage.\pD’ailleurs, désires-tu que
j’apprenne Frappe Atlas\pà un de tes Pokémon?

msgid: Is that so?\nI'm sure you'll be back for it.
msgstr: Vraiment?\nTu me déçois.

msgid: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nSEISMIC TOSS?
msgstr: A quel Pokémon dois-je l’enseigner?

msgid: I hope you won't toss in the towel.\nKeep it up.
msgstr: Je suis sûr que ça te sera\nutile. Bon courage.

msgid: MOON STONE, huh?\pWhat's so special about it?\nLooks like an ordinary rock to me.
msgstr: Pierre Lune?\pOuais? Et alors?

msgid: July 20, 1969!\pHumankind first set foot on the\nmoon that day.\pI bought a color TV just so I\ncould watch that news.
msgstr: 20 Juillet 1969!\pL’homme a marché sur la lune!\pJ’ai acheté une télé couleur pour\nvoir toutes les nuances de la lune!

msgid: This month, we're running a space\nexhibit.
msgstr: Nous faisons une exposition sur\nl’espace.

msgid: I want a PIKACHU!\nIt's so cute!\pI asked my daddy to catch me one!
msgstr: Je veux un PIKACHU!\pPapa va m’en trouver un!

msgid: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!
msgstr: Oui, oui, tu vas l’avoir ton\nPIKACHU… C’est ça.

msgid: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.\nIt is thought to be a MOON STONE.
msgstr: Un météore du Mont Sélénite.\nSerait-ce une Pierre Lune?

msgid: What!?\pTEAM ROCKET is at MT. MOON?\nHuh?\pI'm on the phone!\nScram!
msgstr: Quoi!?\pLa Team Rocket est au Mont\nSélénite!\pDamnation!

msgid: Yawn!\pWhen JIGGLYPUFF sings, POKéMON get\ndrowsy…\p…Me, too…\nSnore…
msgstr: (Bâille)\pLorsque RONDOUDOU chante, tous les\nPokémon piquent du nez…\p… Moi aussi…\n(Ronfl)…

msgid: I really want a PIKACHU, so I'm\ntrading my CLEFAIRY for one.
msgstr: Je veux vraiment un PIKACHU.\nÇa te dit un MELOFEE en échange?

msgid: I'm trading POKéMON with that kid\nthere.\pI had two PIKACHU, so I figured\nI might as well trade one.
msgstr: J’échange des Pokémon avec\nce gamin.\pComme j’avais deux PIKACHU,\nj’en ai échangé un!

msgid:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pI hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child.\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
msgstr:
Je suis Agatha du Conseil 4!\pChen mise de grands espoirs
sur toi!\pSais-tu que ce vieux machin
était jadis beau garçon? Enfin…\lIl y a très longtemps!\pIl veut juste frimer avec son
Pokédex! Mais c’est stupide! Les\lPokémon servent à combattre!\p{PLAYER}! Je vais te montrer
comment les grands Dresseurs\lcombattent!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

msgid:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.\pYou're the child that OAK's taken
under his wing, aren't you?\pThat old duff was once tough and
handsome.\pBut that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.\pNow he just wants to fiddle with
his POKéDEX.\pHe's wrong.
POKéMON are for battling!\p{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real
TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
msgstr:
Je suis Agatha du Conseil 4!\pTu es le Dresseur que Chen
a pris sous son aile, non?\pSais-tu que ce vieux machin
était jadis beau garçon? Enfin…\lIl y a très longtemps!\pIl veut juste frimer avec son
Pokédex! Mais c’est débile! Les\lPokémon servent à combattre!\p{PLAYER}! Je vais te montrer
comment les grands Dresseurs\lcombattent!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

msgid: Oh, my!\nYou're something special, child!
msgstr: Oh ho!\nPas mal, tu as du talent!

msgid: You win!\pI see what the old duff sees in\nyou now.\pI have nothing else to say.\nRun along now, child!
msgstr: Mmmm…\pJe vois pourquoi le vieux Chen\nt’apprécie autant!\pJe n’ai rien à ajouter.\nTu peux passer.

msgid:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!\pThrough rigorous training, people
and POKéMON can become stronger\lwithout limit.\pI've lived and trained with my
fighting POKéMON!\lAnd that will never change!\p{PLAYER}!\pWe will grind you down with our
superior power!\pHoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
msgstr:
Mon nom est Aldo du Conseil 4!\pNotre passion à mes Pokémon
et moi, c’est la muscu!\pJ’ai passé toute ma vie avec mes
Pokémon Combat,\pet c’est pas près de changer!\p{PLAYER}!\pTon équipe…
J’vais en faire du yaourt!\pA table!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

msgid: Why?\nHow could I lose?
msgstr: Pourquoi?\nEt mes muscles?

msgid: My job is done.\nGo face your next challenge.
msgstr: Bien joué!\nTon prochain adversaire t’attend!

msgid:
NO!
That can't be!\lYou beat me at my best!\pAfter all that work to become
the LEAGUE CHAMP?\pMy reign is over already?
It's not fair!
msgstr:
NON! IMPOSSIBLE!!!
Mon équipe de rêve est fichue!\pAprès en avoir tant bavé, je me
fais battre? Et par toi?\pMon rêve de gloire…
Disparu! C’est pas juste!

msgid:
Why?
Why did I lose?\pI never made any mistakes raising
my POKéMON…\pDarn it! You're the new POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION!\pAlthough I don't like to admit it…
msgstr:
Qu… Comm… Hein?
Moi? Pourquoi?\lWHAAAAAAAAAAA!\pJ’ai entraîné mes Pokémon à la
perfection…\pEt zut alors! Tu es le nouveau
Maître de la Ligue Pokémon!\pAlors ça… Ça me sidère.

msgid:
OAK: So, you've won!
Sincerely, congratulations!\pYou're the new POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\pYou've grown up so much since you
first left with {STR_VAR_1} to work\lon the POKéDEX.\p{PLAYER}, you have come of age!
msgstr:
Chen: Tu as gagné!
Félicitations!\pTu es le nouveau Maître de
la Ligue Pokémon!\pTu as tant changé depuis ton
départ avec {STR_VAR_1}.\p{PLAYER}, je suis fier de toi!

msgid:
OAK: {RIVAL}…
I'm disappointed in you.\pI came when I heard you'd beaten
the ELITE FOUR.\pBut, when I got here, you had
already lost!\p{RIVAL}, do you understand why
you lost?\pYou have forgotten to treat your
POKéMON with love and trust.\pWithout them, you will never
become a CHAMP again!
msgstr:
Chen: {RIVAL}!
Je suis… déçu!\pApprenant que tu avais vaincu le
Conseil 4, je suis venu en\lvitesse!\pMais le temps d’arriver jusqu’ici,
tu avais déjà perdu…\p{RIVAL}! As-tu compris pourquoi
ton équipe s’est fait battre?\pTu as oublié de traiter tes
Pokémon avec amour!\pSans ça, tu ne pourras
jamais devenir Champion.

msgid:
OAK: {PLAYER}.\pYou understand that your victory
was not just your own doing.\pThe bond you share with your
POKéMON is marvelous.\p{PLAYER}!
Come with me!
msgstr:
Chen: {PLAYER}!\pTu as compris que tu dois aussi
cette victoire à tes Pokémon.\pLe lien que tu as créé avec eux
est merveilleux.\p{PLAYER}!
Suis-moi!

msgid:
Ah! I've heard about you,
{PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
msgstr:
Ah! Enfin… J’ai entendu parler
de toi, {PLAYER}!\pJe règne sur le Conseil 4!
Mon nom est Peter, le Dresseur\lde dragons!\pLes dragons sont des Pokémon
mythiques!\pLes capturer et les entraîner est
difficile mais leurs pouvoirs\lsont supérieurs!\pIls sont presque invincibles!\pLe glas de la défaite et de la
honte sonne pour toi…\pL’entends-tu, {PLAYER}!?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

msgid:
Ah!
So, you've returned, {PLAYER}!\pI lead the ELITE FOUR.\pYou can call me LANCE the dragon
TRAINER.\pYou know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON.\pThey're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior.\pThey're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.\pWell, are you ready to lose?\pYour LEAGUE challenge ends with
me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
msgstr:
Ah! C’est encore toi,
{PLAYER}!\pJe règne sur le Conseil 4!
Moi, Peter, je suis le Dresseur\lde dragons!\pLes dragons sont des Pokémon
mythiques!\pLes capturer et les entraîner est
difficile mais leurs pouvoirs\lsont supérieurs!\pIls sont presque invincibles!\pLe glas de la défaite et de la
honte sonne pour toi…\pL’entends-tu, {PLAYER}?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

msgid: That's it!\pI hate to admit it, but you are a\nPOKéMON master!
msgstr: Incroyable!\pTu as bien mérité le titre de…\nMaître Pokémon!

msgid:
I still can't believe my dragons
lost to you, {PLAYER}.\pYou are now the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION!\p…Or, you would have been, but
you have one more challenge left.\pThere is one more TRAINER to face!
His name is…\p{RIVAL}!\pHe beat the ELITE FOUR before
you.\pHe is the real POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION.
msgstr:
Comment mes dragons ont-ils
pu succomber à tes attaques,\l{PLAYER}?\pTu es désormais le Maître de
la Ligue Pokémon!\pEnfin… Pas tout à fait. Une
épreuve doit encore t’être\limposée…\pUn grand Dresseur t’attend.
Son nom est…\p{RIVAL}!\pIl a vaincu le Conseil 4
avant toi!\pC’est le vrai Maître de la
Ligue Pokémon!

msgid:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI am LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR.\pNo one can best me when it comes
to icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
msgstr:
Bienvenue à la Ligue Pokémon!\pJe zuis Olga du CONZEIL 4!\pJe zuis la maîtrezze des
Pokémon Glaze!\pPerzonne ne peut les battre…\pTes Pokémon zeront à ma merzi
une fois gelés!\pAch! Ach! Ach!
Z’est parti!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

msgid:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.\pI, LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR,
have returned!\pYou know how it goes.
No one can best me when it comes\lto icy POKéMON.\pFreezing moves are powerful.\pYour POKéMON will be at my mercy
when they are frozen solid.\pHahaha!
Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
msgstr:
Bienvenue à la Ligue Pokémon!\pMoi, Olga du CONZEIL 4
zuis de retour!\pTu sais que je zuis la maîtrezze
des Pokémon Glaze!\pPerzonne ne peut les battre…\pTes Pokémon zeront à ma merzi
une fois gelés!\pAch! Ach! Ach!
Z’est reparti!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

msgid: …Things shouldn't be this way!
msgstr: Za devait pas ze passer comme za!

msgid: You're better than I thought.\nGo on ahead.\pYou only got a taste of the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's power.
msgstr: Tu sais te battre.\nZ’est bien.\pMais la Ligue Pokémon te rézerve\nd’autres zurprizes!

msgid: Who are you?\nThere shouldn't be anyone here.
msgstr: Qui es-tu?\nC’est interdit de se balader ici.

msgid: A key? I don't know what you're\ntalking about.
msgstr: Une clé? Je ne sais pas d’quoi tu\nparles.

msgid: W-w-waah! You startled me!\nI thought you were a ghost.
msgstr: Waaah! J’ai eu peur!!\nJ’ai cru que c’était un fantôme!

msgid: Tch!\nI can't get any wins.
msgstr: Pffff!\nJ’arrive jamais à gagner!

msgid: I was exploring here by myself,\nbut I feel spooked.\pI ought to go soon.
msgstr: Je suis venu en exploration.\nMais je me sens épié.\pFaut que je parte vite d’ici.

msgid: A secret switch!\pPress it?
msgstr: Un bouton secret!\pAppuyer dessus?

msgid: Who wouldn't?
msgstr: Qui ne le ferait pas?

msgid: Not quite yet!
msgstr: Pas vraiment!

msgid: I can't get out!\nThis old place is one big puzzle.
msgstr: Mais…\nJ’suis complètement paumé!

msgid: Oh, no!\nMy bag of loot!
msgstr: Non!\nMon butin!

msgid: The switches here open and close\nalternating sets of doors.
msgstr: Les interrupteurs ouvrent et\nferment alternativement les portes!

msgid: Diary: July 5\nGuyana, South America\pA new POKéMON was discovered deep\nin the jungle.
msgstr: Rapport: 5 Juillet.\nJungle X.\pUn nouveau type de Pokémon\na été découvert.

msgid: Diary: July 10\nWe christened the newly discovered\lPOKéMON, MEW.
msgstr: Rapport: 10 Juillet.\nLe Pokémon a été baptisé MEW.

msgid: This place is, like, huge!
msgstr: Fouiii… C’est grand ici!

msgid: Ayah!
msgstr: Yargl!

msgid: I wonder where my partner went.
msgstr: Mais où est donc mon complice?

msgid: My mentor once lived here.
msgstr: Mon mentor vivait ici autrefois.

msgid: Whew!\nOverwhelming!
msgstr: !!!\nImpressionnant!

msgid: So, you're stuck?\nTry jumping off over there!
msgstr: T’as perdu ton chemin?\nEssaie de sauter par là-bas!

msgid: Diary: Feb. 6\nMEW gave birth.\pWe named the newborn MEWTWO.
msgstr: Rapport: 6 Février.\nMEW est papa (ou maman?).\pLe petit a été baptisé MEWTWO.

msgid: Uh-oh…\nWhere am I now?
msgstr: Oh-oh.\nOù que je suis, moi?

msgid: Awooh!
msgstr: Oups.

msgid: You can find stuff lying around.\nThe residents must've left them.
msgstr: De bons objets traînent dans\nle coin.

msgid: This place is ideal for a lab.\nLook at all this space.
msgstr: La science?\nC’est le pied.

msgid: What was that for?
msgstr: … Bah pourquoi?

msgid: I like it here.\nIt's conducive to my studies.
msgstr: J’adore cet endroit! J’y fais mon\ninternat!

msgid: Diary: Sept. 1\nMEWTWO is far too powerful.\pWe have failed to curb its vicious\ntendencies…
msgstr: Rapport: 1er Septembre.\nMEWTWO est trop puissant.\pNous sommes impuissants face à\nses pièges…

msgid: POKéMON TOWER was erected in the\nmemory of POKéMON that died.
msgstr: La Tour Pokémon a été érigée en\nmémoire des braves Pokémon\ldisparus au combat.

msgid: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\nson.
msgstr: Tu es venu leur rendre hommage?\pC’est tout à ton honneur,\nmon petit!

msgid: Did you come to pay respects?\pBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\ngirl.
msgstr: Tu es venu leur rendre hommage?\pC’est tout à ton honneur,\nma petite!

msgid: I came to pray for my dearly\ndeparted CLEFAIRY.\pSniff!\nI'm awash in tears…
msgstr: Je suis venu prier pour mon\nMELOFEE.\pSniff!\nJ’arrête pas de pleurer…

msgid: My GROWLITHE…\nWhy did you die?
msgstr: Mon CANINOS…\nTu me manques…

msgid: I am a CHANNELER.\pThere are spirits up to mischief.\nI sense them high in the TOWER.
msgstr: Je suis une Exorciste!\nJe chasse les esprits!

msgid: {RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!\nWhat brings you here?\lIs your POKéMON dead?\pHey! It's alive!\pI can at least make them faint!\nLet's go!
msgstr: {RIVAL}: Hé, {PLAYER}!\nQu’est-ce que tu fais là?\lTes Pokémon sont pas morts?\pJe peux quand même les mettre\nKO! Aucun problème!

msgid: What?\nYou stinker!\pI took it easy on you, too!
msgstr: Hein?\nSaleté, va!\pJe ne jouais pas sérieusement!

msgid:
How's your POKéDEX coming?
I just caught a CUBONE!\pI can't find the bigger MAROWAK.
Where could they be?\pI bet there aren't any left!\pWell, I better get going.
I've got a lot to accomplish,\lunlike you.\pSmell ya later!
msgstr:
Où en est ton Pokédex?
Je viens de capturer un OSSELAIT!\pJe n’ai pas encore trouvé
d’OSSATUEUR!\pJe crois qu’il n’en reste plus!\pJe dois y aller! J’ai du
pain sur la planche!\pTchao!

msgid: Even we could not identify the\nwayward ghosts.\pA SILPH SCOPE might be able to\nunmask them.
msgstr: Nous ne pouvons pas identifier\nles Spectres!\pUn Scope Sylphe pourrait les\ndémasquer.

msgid: Urrg… Awaa…\nHuhu… Graa…
msgstr: Urrg… Awaa…\nHuhu… graa…

msgid: Hwa!\nI'm saved!
msgstr: Ha!\nJe suis sauvée!

msgid: The ghosts can be identified by\nthe SILPH SCOPE.
msgstr: Un Spectre est identifiable avec\nun Scope Sylphe.

msgid: Hmm?\nWhat am I doing?
msgstr: Hmm?\nQu’est-ce que je fais là?

msgid: Sorry!\nI was possessed!
msgstr: Pardon!\nJ’étais possédée!

msgid: Be gone!\nMalevolent spirit!
msgstr: Vade Rétro!\nEsprit infernal!

msgid: Whew!\nThe spirit left!
msgstr: Pfiou!\nL’esprit s’en est allé!

msgid: The others above…\nThey must have been possessed.
msgstr: Mes amies étaient aussi possédées!

msgid: Ghost! No!\nKwaaah!
msgstr: Un Spectre!\nRhaaaaaa!

msgid: Where is the ghost?
msgstr: Ben! Où est le Spectre?

msgid: Be cursed with me!\nKwaaah!
msgstr: Sois maudit!!!!\nKwaaah!

msgid: We can't determine the identity of\nthe ghosts…
msgstr: Nous ne pouvons pas identifier\nles Spectres.

msgid: Huhuhu…\nBeat me not!
msgstr: Huhuhu…\nNe me frappe pas!

msgid: May the departed POKéMON rest in\npeace…
msgstr: Que les âmes des Pokémon\ndisparus reposent en paix!

msgid: Come, child!\nI have purified this space.\lYou can rest here.
msgstr: Approche, enfant!\pJ’ai scellé cet endroit grâce à\nma sainte magie blanche!\pTu peux te reposer ici!

msgid: Give…me…\nyour…all…
msgstr: Donne… moi…\nton… âme…

msgid: Gasp!
msgstr: Glargh!

msgid: I was under possession.
msgstr: J’étais possédée!

msgid: You…shall…\njoin…us…
msgstr: Viens… avec…\nnous…

msgid: What a nightmare!
msgstr: Hein! J’ai fait un cauchemar!

msgid: I was possessed.
msgstr: J’étais possédée!

msgid: Zombies!
msgstr: Zombis!

msgid: I regained my senses.
msgstr: Je suis revenue à la raison!

msgid: Urgah…\nUrff…
msgstr: Poyé Polomi!\nLe mal est parmi nous…

msgid: Whoo!
msgstr: Quoi?\nJeune taoïste, tu oses m’ôter le\lyang de la bouche!

msgid: I fell to evil spirits despite my\ntraining in the mountains…
msgstr: Mon Tao à moi, c’est le plus beau\ndes Taos!

msgid: Entered the purified and protected\nzone.\p{PLAYER}'s POKéMON were fully\nhealed.
msgstr: Vous pénétrez dans une zone\nsanctuaire!\pLes Pokémon de {PLAYER} sont\nsoignés!

msgid: Give…me…\nblood…
msgstr: Ton… sang…\nDonne…

msgid: Groan!
msgstr: Grargh!

msgid: I feel anemic and weak…
msgstr: Je me sens faible…

msgid: Urff…\nKwaah!
msgstr: Urff… Kwaah!

msgid: Something fell out!
msgstr: Haaa! Je me sens mieux!

msgid: My hair didn't fall out!\nIt was a malevolent spirit!
msgstr: J’étais sous l’emprise d’un\nesprit!

msgid: Ke…ke…ke…\nke…ke…ke!
msgstr: Ke… ke… ke….\nke… ke… ke!!

msgid: Keee!
msgstr: Keee!

msgid: What's going on here?
msgstr: Mais qu’est-ce qui se passe ici?

msgid: Be gone…\nIntruders…
msgstr: Fuis…\nMisérable…

msgid: The ghost was the restless spirit\nof CUBONE's mother!
msgstr: Le Spectre était l’esprit damné de\nla mère d’OSSELAIT!

msgid: The mother's spirit was calmed.\pIt departed to the afterlife…
msgstr: L’âme de la mère a été apaisée.\pElle est partie vers l’autre monde!

msgid: What do you want?\nWhy are you here?
msgstr: Que veux-tu?\nQue cherches-tu?

msgid: I'm not going to forget this!
msgstr: Je ne t’oublierai pas!

msgid:
This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT.\pThen, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.\pSo, we're just talking it over as
adults.
msgstr: Ce vieil homme est venu nous\ndemander de ne plus troubler les\lgentils Pokémon!\pAlors on a discuté tranquillement\nentre adultes.

msgid: Please!\nNo more!
msgstr: Argh!\nAssez!

msgid: POKéMON are only good for making\nmoney. Why not use them?\pYou stay out of our business!
msgstr: Les Pokémon ne servent qu’à\ngagner de l’argent!\pReste en dehors de nos affaires!

msgid: You're not saving anyone, kid!
msgstr: Y’a personne à sauver ici!

msgid: Don't fight us ROCKETS!
msgstr: Hmm! N’affronte pas la Team Rocket!

msgid: You're not getting away with this!
msgstr: Tu ne t’en sortiras pas comme ça!

msgid:
MR. FUJI: Heh?
You came to save me?\pThank you. But, I came here of my
own free will.\pI came to calm the spirit of
CUBONE's mother.\pI think MAROWAK's spirit has
finally left us.\pI must thank you for your kind
concern.\pFollow me to my home, POKéMON
HOUSE, at the foot of this tower.
msgstr:
M. Fuji: Hé?
Tu es là pour me sauver?\pMerci! Mais je suis venu ici de
mon plein gré.\pJe voulais apaiser l’esprit
de la mère d’OSSELAIT.\pJe pense que l’esprit
d’OSSATUEUR s’en est allé\lvers les cieux.\pJe dois te remercier pour
ton attention.\pViens avec moi dans ma maison,
la Maison Pokémon au pied de\lcette tour.

msgid: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!
msgstr: Il est long ce tunnel, oh oui!

msgid: Doh!\nYou win!
msgstr: Rôooh!\nT’as gagné!

msgid: Watch for ONIX.\nThey appear only occasionally.\pHigh-level ones can put the\nsqueeze on you!
msgstr: Attention aux ONIX!\nIls apparaissent souvent ici.\pIls pourraient facilement \nt’écrabouiller, fais attention!

msgid: Hmm.\nMaybe I'm lost in here…
msgstr: Bon, bon, bon, je suis perdu…

msgid: Ease up!\nWhat am I doing?\lWhich way is out?
msgstr: Hein?\nPar où je sors maintenant?

msgid: That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12\nforced me to take this detour.
msgstr: Ce Pokémon endormi sur la route 12\nm’a obligé à faire un détour.

msgid: Outsiders like you need to show me\nsome respect!
msgstr: Un profane comme toi me doit le\nrespect!

msgid: You're talented enough to hike!
msgstr: Tu as le niveau des meilleurs\nmontagnards!

msgid: POKéMON fight!\nReady, go!
msgstr: Baston Pokémon!\nC’est parti!

msgid: Game over!
msgstr: Game over!
detail: remplace [relu et corrigé à la main (le patch FR actuel donnait un morceau]

msgid: Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!
msgstr: Bon, il me faut un NOSFERAPTI!

msgid: Eek!\pDon't try anything funny in the\ndark!
msgstr: Hep!\pDans le noir, fais gaffe où tu mets\nles pieds!

msgid: It was too dark…
msgstr: J’ai rien compris!

msgid: I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.
msgstr: J’ai vu un MACHOC dans ce tunnel!

msgid: I came this far looking for wild\nPOKéMON.
msgstr: Je viens de loin pour ces Pokémon\nsauvages!

msgid: I'm out of POKéMON!
msgstr: Oh! Plus de Pokémon!

msgid: You looked cute and harmless.\nWas I ever wrong!
msgstr: Dire que je pensais que tu ne\nsavais pas te battre.

msgid: You have POKéMON!\nLet's start!
msgstr: T’as des Pokémon!\nOK, bastooonn!

msgid: You play hard!
msgstr: T’es coriace toi!

msgid: Whew!\nI'm all sweaty now.
msgstr: Hé ben!\nMe voilà en sueur!

msgid: Do you know how you can avoid\ngetting lost in the mountains?\pYou can bend twigs as trail\nmarkers.
msgstr: Tu sais comment éviter de te\nperdre?\pIl suffit de laisser des petites\nbrindilles derrière toi.

msgid: Ohhh!\nI did my best!
msgstr: Oh!\nJ’ai fait de mon mieux!

msgid: Hahaha!\nCan you beat my power?
msgstr: Hahaha!\nJ’suis trop fort!

msgid: Oops!\nOutmuscled!
msgstr: Oups!\nNiveau muscles: zéro!

msgid: I go for power because I hate\nthinking.
msgstr: J’aime pas penser alors je cogne.

msgid: You have a POKéDEX?\nI want one, too.
msgstr: Tu as un Pokédex?\nJ’en veux un aussi!

msgid: Shoot!\nI am so jealous!
msgstr: Zut!\nJ’suis jaloux!

msgid: When you finish your POKéDEX,\ncan I have it?
msgstr: Tu me donneras ton Pokédex\nplus tard?

msgid: Um… Do you know about POKéMON\ncosplay?
msgstr: Connais-tu les Dresseurs costumés?

msgid: Well, that's that.
msgstr: Ben… C’est ça.

msgid: POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as\nPOKéMON for fun.\pCLEFAIRY is a favorite.
msgstr: Les Dresseurs costumés se\ndéguisent en Pokémon pour s’amuser.\pIls adorent le costume de MELOFEE.

msgid: My POKéMON techniques will leave\nyou crying!
msgstr: Mes Pokémon vont te faire pleurer!

msgid: I give!\nYou're a better technician!
msgstr: Ah!\nJe pleure.

msgid: In mountains, you'll often find\nROCK-type POKéMON.
msgstr: Les montagnes regorgent de\nPokémon du type Roche.

msgid: I don't often come here, but I will\nbattle you.
msgstr: J’suis paumée mais…\nA l’attaque!

msgid: Oh!\nI lost!
msgstr: Oh!\nPerdu!

msgid: I like tiny POKéMON.\nBig ones are too scary!
msgstr: J’aime les petits Pokémon, les gros\nme font peur!

msgid: Hit me with your best shot!
msgstr: Donne-toi à fond!

msgid: Fired away!
msgstr: Mince! J’me suis fait détruire!

msgid: I'll raise my POKéMON to beat\nyours, kid.
msgstr: Je vais encore m’entraîner!

msgid: I draw illustrations of POKéMON\nwhen I'm home.
msgstr: Je dessine des Pokémon quand\nj’suis tout seul.\l…\lCool, non?

msgid: Whew…\nI'm exhausted…
msgstr: Fouii!\nJe suis crevé!

msgid: I'm an artist, not a fighter.\nI'll go home to draw.
msgstr: J’suis un artiste, pas un violent.

msgid: Who are you?\nHow did you get here?
msgstr: T’es qui? T’as fait comment\npour entrer ici?

msgid: Oww!\nBeaten!
msgstr: Aïe!\nJ’suis battu!

msgid: Blast it… You're dissing TEAM\nROCKET, aren't you?
msgstr: Qu’est-ce que tu as contre\nla Team Rocket?

msgid: You broke into TEAM ROCKET's\noperation? What nerve!
msgstr: Tu as cassé nos plans!!!

msgid: You're not going to get away with\nthis, brat!
msgstr: Non, non! Tu ne t’en tireras pas\ncomme ça!

msgid: Intruder alert!
msgstr: Intrus! ALERTE! ALERTE!

msgid: I can't do it!
msgstr: J’ai… échoué!!!

msgid: SILPH SCOPE? Humph!\nI don't know where it is.
msgstr: Scope Sylphe?\nC’est quoi donc?

msgid: Why did you come here?
msgstr: Tiens, pourquoi t’es là?

msgid: This won't do!
msgstr: J’suis pas à la hauteur!

msgid: Okay, I'll talk…\nTake the elevator to see my BOSS.
msgstr: OK, OK, je parle! Prends donc\nl’ascenseur et tu verras mon chef!

msgid: Are you lost, you little mouse?
msgstr: T’as perdu ton chemin?

msgid: Why…?
msgstr: Quoi…?

msgid: Uh-oh, that ruckus somehow opened\nthe door!
msgstr: Oups, ce combat a ouvert la porte!

msgid: BOSS said you can see ghosts with\nthe SILPH SCOPE.
msgstr: Le chef dit qu’on peut voir les\nfantômes avec un Scope Sylphe!

msgid: The TEAM ROCKET HQ has four\nunderground floors.\pThink you can reach the BOSS?
msgstr: Le repaire de la Team Rocket a\n4 niveaux souterrains.\pPourras-tu arriver jusqu’au chef?

msgid: Stop meddling in TEAM ROCKET's\naffairs or else!
msgstr: Ne te mêle plus des affaires de la\nTeam Rocket!

msgid: Oof!\nTaken down!
msgstr: Paf!\nJ’suis au tapis!

msgid: SILPH SCOPE?\nOh, that machine the BOSS stole.\pIt's here somewhere.
msgstr: Le Scope Sylphe?\nLe bidule que le chef a volé?\pIl est là, quelque part…

msgid: We got word from upstairs that you\nwere coming!
msgstr: On nous a prévenus de ton arrivée!

msgid: What?\nI lost? No!
msgstr: Quoi?\nJ’ai perdu? NON!

msgid: Go ahead and go!\pBut you can't run the elevator\nwithout the LIFT KEY.
msgstr: Allez, continue!\pMais il te faut la Clé Asc. pour\nl’ascenseur!

msgid:
So! I must say, I am impressed you
got here.\pTEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from
around the world.\pThey're important tools for keeping
our criminal enterprise going.\pI am the leader, GIOVANNI!\pFor your insolence, you will feel a
world of pain!
msgstr:
Hmm! Tu me surprends. T’es dans le
genre coriace!\pPour financer ses plans, la Team
Rocket a besoin de Pokémon!\pPour ça, nous en capturons dans le
monde entier.\pEt je suis le chef, moi…
Giovanni!\pJe vais te punir pour ton
insolence!

msgid: WHAT!\nThis can't be!
msgstr: QUOI?\nDamnation!

msgid: I see that you raise POKéMON with\nutmost care.\pA child like you would never\nunderstand what I hope to achieve.\pI shall step aside this time!\pI hope we meet again…
msgstr:
Tu élèves tes Pokémon avec
le plus grand soin.\pUn gosse comme toi ne peut
comprendre mes plans!\pTu as gagné cette bataille, mais
pas la guerre…\pOn se retrouvera, et cette fois…

msgid: I know you!\nYou ruined our plans at MT. MOON!
msgstr: Je te reconnais!\nTu as ruiné nos plans au\lMont Sélénite!

msgid: Burned again!
msgstr: Enfer! Et encore enfer!

msgid: Do you have something against TEAM\nROCKET?
msgstr: Je comprends pas, t’aimes pas la\nTeam Rocket?

msgid: How can you not see the beauty of\nour evil?
msgstr: Tu ne trouves pas que nos plans\nmaléfiques sont super cool?

msgid: Ayaya!
msgstr: Ayayargh!

msgid: BOSS!\nI'm sorry I failed you!
msgstr: Chef! Pardon!\nJ’ai échoué…

msgid: The elevator doesn't work?\nWho has the LIFT KEY?
msgstr: L’ascenseur ne marche pas?\nIl faut la Clé Asc.!

msgid: Oh, no!\nI dropped the LIFT KEY!
msgstr: Mince! J’ai laissé tomber\nla Clé Asc.!

msgid: It appears to need a key.
msgstr: Il faut une clé.

msgid: Wow, you came all the way here?\nMaybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?\lWant to see my collection?
msgstr: T’es dingue des Pokémon?\nTu veux voir ma collec’?

msgid: Humph.\nI'm not angry!
msgstr: Nyan!\nMa belle collec’!

msgid: I have more rare POKéMON at home!
msgstr: A la maison, j’ai plein de Pokémon\nsuper rares!

msgid: Ha-haha!\nNot laughing!\lHa-hay fever! Haha-ha-choo!
msgstr: Ha!\nJe ris pas!\lC’est les nerfs!

msgid: Haha-ha-choo!\nHa-choo!\lSnort! Snivel!
msgstr: Haha-ha-ha!\nNyahahahaha!\lHohohoho!

msgid: Hi, kid!\nWant to see my POKéMON?
msgstr: Hé, toi!\nTu veux voir mes Pokémon?

msgid: Oh, no!\nMy POKéMON!
msgstr: Yah!\nMes Pokémon!

msgid: I don't like you.\nI don't like anyone better than me!
msgstr: Je t’aime pas et j’aime pas\nquand tu gagnes!

msgid: I've been out at a POKéMON GYM\na few times.\p…But I always lose.
msgstr: Je reviens de l’Arène Pokémon!\nMais je perds tout le temps!

msgid: Ohh!\nAfter all my training!
msgstr: Ben, voilà!\nJ’ai encore perdu!

msgid: I noticed some POKéMANIACS\nprowling around.\pCan you imagine? Them?\nUp here in the mountains?
msgstr: J’ai rencontré des POKéMANIACS\ndans le coin.

msgid: Ah!\nThis mountain air is delicious!
msgstr: Ah! L’air de la montagne, c’est\nvivifiant!

msgid: That cleared my head!
msgstr: Ben… Me voilà tout vivifié!

msgid: I feel bloated on mountain air!
msgstr: J’en ai marre de la montagne!

msgid: I'm feeling a bit faint.\nI haven't hiked in some time.
msgstr: Cette randonnée m’a épuisée!

msgid: I'm too tired.\nI wasn't up for it.
msgstr: Trop fatiguée.\nJ’laisse tomber!

msgid: The POKéMON here in the mountains\nare so chunky…\pI wish there were pink POKéMON\nwith a floral pattern!
msgstr: Les Pokémon de la montagne\nsont trop trapus!\pIl en faudrait des roses en forme\nde jolies fleurs!

msgid: ROCK TUNNEL\nDetour to LAVENDER TOWN
msgstr: Grotte\nDétour pour Lavanville

msgid: The types of POKéMON match up\ndifferently with each other.\pEvery type is stronger than some\ntypes and weaker than others.
msgstr: Le type d’un Pokémon l’avantage\nou pas par rapport aux autres.\pChaque type a des avantages et\ndes inconvénients.

msgid: A NUGGET is totally useless.\nSo I sold it for ¥5000.
msgstr: J’ai vendu une Pépite pour 5000¥!

msgid: I heard that ghosts haunt\nLAVENDER TOWN.
msgstr: On m’a dit qu’il y a des Spectres\nà Lavanville!

msgid:
Oh… {PLAYER}!
I've been looking for you!\pIt's me, one of the ever-present
AIDES to PROF. OAK.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on twenty species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward from PROF. OAK.\pHe entrusted me with this
EVERSTONE.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
twenty kinds of POKéMON?
msgstr:
Salut, {PLAYER}! Je te cherchais.
Je suis un assistant du Prof. Chen!\pSi tu attrapes vingt Pokémon
différents, je suis censé t’offrir\lcette Pierre Stase!\pAlors {PLAYER}, as-tu attrapé au
moins vingt Pokémon différents?

msgid: Great! You have caught or owned\n{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!\pCongratulations!\nHere you go!
msgstr: Super! Tu as {STR_VAR_3} Pokémon\ndifférents!\pFélicitations!\nVoici ta récompense!

msgid: {PLAYER} received the EVERSTONE\nfrom the AIDE.
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient une\nPierre Stase!

msgid:
Making POKéMON evolve certainly
can add to the POKéDEX.\pHowever, at times, you may not
want a certain POKéMON to evolve.\pIn that case, give the EVERSTONE
to that POKéMON.\pIt will prevent evolution according
to the PROFESSOR.
msgstr:
Tu peux agrandir ton Pokédex
en faisant évoluer tes Pokémon.\pMais il se peut que tu ne veuilles
pas faire évoluer un Pokémon.\pDans ce cas, donne cette
Pierre Stase à ton Pokémon.\pSelon le Professeur, ça
l’empêchera d’évoluer.

msgid:
Don't you think it's hard to think
up good names for POKéMON?\pEspecially if you've caught a
whole bunch?\pIn LAVENDER TOWN, there's a man
who rates POKéMON nicknames.\pHe can even help you rename your
POKéMON, too.
msgstr:
C’est dur de donner un surnom sympa
à ses Pokémon!\pA Lavanville, un vieil homme
juge les noms des Pokémon.\pIl peut même 
t’aider à les renommer!

msgid: If you're aiming to reach LAVENDER\nTOWN, take ROCK TUNNEL.\pYou can get to ROCK TUNNEL from\nCERULEAN CITY.
msgstr: Si tu veux aller à Lavanville,\npasse par la Grotte.\pTu peux l’emprunter en passant\npar Azuria.

msgid:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?
msgstr:
Salut! Tu te rappelles de moi?
Je suis un assistant du Prof. Chen!\pSi tu attrapes {STR_VAR_1} Pokémon
différents, je suis censé\lt’offrir… {STR_VAR_2}!\pAlors {PLAYER}, as-tu attrapé au
moins {STR_VAR_1} Pokémon différents?

msgid: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_2}\nfrom the AIDE.
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient\n{STR_VAR_2}!

msgid:
There are items on the ground that
may be hidden from view.\pUse the ITEMFINDER to detect any
hidden items close to you.\pThe machine is a bit limited.
It can't pinpoint item locations.\pWhat it does is show the direction
where the item is.\pUse it to get your bearings, then
search the suspect area by hand.
msgstr:
Il y a des objets au sol qui
sont difficiles à voir.\pUtilise le Cherch’Objet pour
détecter les objets près de toi.\pLa machine n’est pas très précise,\pelle n’indique que la direction
où chercher.\pUtilise-la pour les localiser, et
finis de les chercher en fouinant.

msgid: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA big POKéMON is asleep on a road!
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles.\pUn énorme Pokémon dort sur la\nroute!

msgid: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pWhat a breathtaking view!
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles.\pC’est très beau!\n… Bon! On y va?

msgid:
Let's see what the binoculars have
to show…\pTo get to LAVENDER TOWN from
CERULEAN CITY…\pROCK TUNNEL appears to be a good
route to take.
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles.\pIl n’y a qu’un seul chemin pour\naller d’Azuria à Lavanville:\lla Grotte!

msgid: Win, lose, or draw!
msgstr: Tu veux gagner ou perdre?

msgid: Atcha!\nDidn't go my way!
msgstr: OK.\nT’as gagné!

msgid: POKéMON is life!\nAnd to live is to play games!
msgstr: Les Pokémon c’est la vie!\nEt la vie c’est le jeu!

msgid: Competition!\nI can't get enough!
msgstr: J’adore les défis!

msgid: I had a chance!
msgstr: J’ai eu ma chance!

msgid: You can't be a coward in the world\nof POKéMON!
msgstr: Dans le monde merveilleux des\nPokémon, y’a pas de lâches!

msgid: Let's go, but don't cheat!
msgstr: On y va! Mais triche pas!

msgid: Huh?\nThat's not right!
msgstr: Rha!\nC’est pas vrai!

msgid: Careful!\nI'm laying down some cables!
msgstr: Attention!\nJe pose des câbles!

msgid: That was electric!
msgstr: J’me suis pris du jus!

msgid: Spread the word to save energy!
msgstr: Il faut économiser l’énergie!

msgid: I just became a TRAINER.\nBut, I think I can win.
msgstr: Je suis nouveau, mais je sais que\nje peux gagner!

msgid: My POKéMON couldn't win…\nHaven't they grown enough?
msgstr: Mes Pokémon sont nuls!\nBeuh…\pJ’ai pas dû les faire assez\nprogresser.

msgid: What now?\nLeave me alone!
msgstr: Quoi encore?\nLaisse-moi!

msgid: Fwahaha!\nI have never lost!
msgstr: HAHAHA!\nJ’ai jamais perdu!

msgid: My first loss!
msgstr: Heu? Ma première défaite!

msgid: You were just lucky, that's all.
msgstr: Tu as la chance des débutants!

msgid: I have never won before…
msgstr: Je n’ai encore jamais gagné…

msgid: I saw this coming…
msgstr: Je m’y attendais…

msgid: I was unlucky, as always.
msgstr: J’suis maudit, je crois!

msgid: I'm the best in my class.\nI train every morning.
msgstr: Je suis le plus fort de ma classe!

msgid: Darn!\nMy POKéMON need to be stronger!
msgstr: Argh!\nTu veux être le chef de classe?

msgid: There's a fat POKéMON that comes\ndown from the mountains.\pI bet it'd be strong if you can\ncatch it.
msgstr: Il y a un gros Pokémon qui vient\nde la montagne.\pSi t’es fort, tu pourrais l’attraper.

msgid: Watch out for live wires!
msgstr: Fais attention aux câbles!

msgid: Whoa!\nYou spark plug!
msgstr: Whoa!\nTu fais des étincelles!

msgid: Well, better get back to work.
msgstr: Bon, j’ai du boulot, moi!

msgid: I raised my POKéMON carefully.\nThey should be ready by now!
msgstr: Mes Pokémon sont prêts!

msgid: Bye-bye!\nThank you, and good-bye!
msgstr: Trop, trop balèze!

msgid: Tch…\nI better go find stronger ones!
msgstr: Faut que j’en chope des\nplus forts!

msgid: I'm the FISHING GURU's younger\nbrother.\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?
msgstr: Je suis le frère du Maître\nPêcheur!\pMoi, dans la vie, j’suis pêcheur!\nJ’adore ça!\pT’aimes la pêche, toi?

msgid: {PLAYER} received a SUPER ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU's brother.
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient la\nMéga Canne!

msgid:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend.\pNow, I have a request.\pIf you catch a big MAGIKARP 
with that ROD, I want to see it.\pAs much as I love to fish, I also
love seeing gigantic MAGIKARP.
msgstr:
La pêche, c’est comme la vie!\pQuand ça mord, ça va! 
Quand ça mord pas, ça va pas!\pJ’ai un service à te demander.
Si tu attrapes un gros MAGICARPE\pavec cette canne, j’aimerais
beaucoup que tu me le montres.\pJ’adore voir les gros MAGICARPE,
presque autant que la pêche.

msgid:
Hello there, {PLAYER}!
Have you been fishing?\pTry fishing with the SUPER ROD in
any body of water.\pYou'll find different POKéMON in
different places.\pOh, and don't forget to bring me
gigantic MAGIKARP.
msgstr:
Salut, {PLAYER}!\pAvec cette Méga Canne, tu vas
vider les océans de tous leurs\pPokémon. Selon les endroits, tu
en trouveras des différents.\pEt n’oublie pas de me montrer
un gros MAGICARPE!

msgid: Oh? {PLAYER}?\nWhy, if it isn't a MAGIKARP!\pAllow me to see it, quick!
msgstr: {PLAYER}?\pTu m’as ramené un MAGICARPE?\nVite vite, je veux le voir!

msgid:
… … …Whoa!
{STR_VAR_2} inches!\pYou have a rare appreciation for
the fine, poetic aspects of fishing!\pYou must take this.
I insist!
msgstr: … Waouh! {STR_VAR_2}cm!\nIl est gigantesque!\pLa pêche n’a plus de secret\npour toi.\pPrends ça, j’insiste!

msgid: I'll look forward to seeing greater\nrecords from you!
msgstr: J’ai hâte de voir tes prochaines\nprises!

msgid: Huh?\n{STR_VAR_2} inches?\pThis is the same size as the one\nI saw before.
msgstr: Hein?\n{STR_VAR_2} cm?\pC’est la même taille que la\ndernière fois.

msgid: Hmm…\nThis one is {STR_VAR_2} inches long.\pIt doesn't measure up to the\n{STR_VAR_3}-inch one you brought before.
msgstr: Hmmm…\nCelui-là fait {STR_VAR_2} cm de long.\pRien à voir avec celui de {STR_VAR_3} cm\nque tu avais ramené.

msgid: Uh… That doesn't look much like\na MAGIKARP.
msgstr: Hmmm…\pÇa ressemble pas à\nun MAGICARPE.

msgid: Oh, no!\pI had a gift for you, but you have\nno room for it.
msgstr: Ah ben non!\pJ’avais un cadeau pour toi, mais\nt’as plus de place!

msgid: The most gigantic MAGIKARP\nI have ever witnessed…\p{STR_VAR_3} inches!
msgstr: Le plus gros MAGICARPE que\nj’ai vu!\p{STR_VAR_3} cm!

msgid: It's a blank chart of some sort.\pIt has spaces for writing in\nrecords of some kind.
msgstr: C’est un classement vierge.\pIl y a de la place pour inscrire\ndes records.

msgid: A POKéMON is sprawled out in\na deep and comfortable slumber.
msgstr: Un Pokémon endormi bloque le\nchemin!

msgid: SNORLAX woke up!\pIt attacked in a grumpy rage!
msgstr: RONFLEX se réveille!\pIl est de mauvais poil!\nIl vous attaque!

msgid: SNORLAX calmed down.\nIt gave a huge yawn…\lAnd returned to the mountains.
msgstr: RONFLEX, une fois calmé, s’en\nretourne vers la montagne!

msgid: Want to use the POKé FLUTE?
msgstr: Tu veux utiliser la POKéFLUTE?

msgid: Yeah!\nI got a bite here!
msgstr: Ouais! Ça mord dans l’coin!

msgid: Tch!\nJust a small fry…
msgstr: Tsss!\nTrop p’tit!

msgid: Hang on!\nMy line's snagged!
msgstr: Bouge pas!\nJ’ai une touche!

msgid: Be patient.\nFishing is a waiting game.
msgstr: Patience!\nPour pêcher, faut être tranquille!

msgid: That one got away!
msgstr: Je l’ai laissé filer!

msgid: With a better ROD, I could catch\nbetter POKéMON…
msgstr: Pour pêcher des Pokémon plus\ngros, il me faut une super Canne!

msgid: I'm searching for a MOON STONE.\nHave you found one?
msgstr: As-tu trouvé une Pierre Lune?

msgid: I could have made my POKéMON\nevolve with a MOON STONE.\pI would have won then, I bet.
msgstr: J’aurais pu faire évoluer mes\nPokémon avec une Pierre Lune!\pEt là, j’aurais gagné, c’est sûr!

msgid: Electricity is my specialty.\pI don't know a thing about POKéMON\nof the sea, though.
msgstr: L’électricité, c’est ma spécialité!

msgid: Unplugged!
msgstr: Court-jus!

msgid: Water conducts electricity, so you\nshould zap sea POKéMON.
msgstr: L’eau conduit l’électricité. Planque\ntous tes Pokémon aquatiques!

msgid: The FISHING FOOL versus POKéMON\nKID!
msgstr: Le Pêcheur Fou contre le Kid des\nPokémon!

msgid: Touch too much!
msgstr: T’as gagné!

msgid: I guess you get to be good at\nwhat you like.\pWell, you beat me at POKéMON,\nbut you can't top me at fishing.
msgstr: Tu m’as battu, mais…\nj’suis plus fort à la pêche!

msgid: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.\pBut it'd be best if I also had more\nwork.
msgstr: Bon, j’ai du pain sur la planche!

msgid: It's not easy…
msgstr: C’est pas facile…

msgid: It's all right.\nLosing doesn't bug me anymore.
msgstr: C’est bon.\nPerdre ne me fait plus peur.

msgid: What's catching?\pYou never know what you could\ncatch!
msgstr: On ne sait jamais ce que l’on peut\nattraper!

msgid: Lost it!
msgstr: Hop, perdu!

msgid: What, MAGIKARP?\pI catch them all the time, sure.\nBut, boy are they wimpy.
msgstr: J’arrête pas d’attraper des\nMAGICARPE, mais ils sont nuls!

msgid: ROUTE 12 \nNorth to LAVENDER
msgstr: Route 12 \nLavanville au Nord

msgid: SPORTFISHING AREA
msgstr: Zone de Pêche

msgid: JES: If I win, I'm going to\npropose to GIA.
msgstr: Jes: Si je gagne, je demande à\nGia de m’épouser.

msgid: JES: Oh, please, why couldn't you\nlet us win?
msgstr: Jes: Tu aurais au moins pu faire\nsemblant de perdre.

msgid: JES: Oh, GIA, forgive me,\nmy love!
msgstr: Jes: Oh, Gia, pardonne-moi!

msgid: JES: GIA and I, we'll be\ntogether forever.\pWe won't battle unless you have\ntwo POKéMON of your own.
msgstr: Jes: Gia et moi, on est ensemble\npour la vie.\pOn ne se battra pas avant que\ntu ramènes deux Pokémon.

msgid: GIA: Hey, JES…\pIf we win, I'll marry you!
msgstr: Gia: Jes…\nSi on gagne, je t’épouse!

msgid: GIA: Oh, but why?
msgstr: Gia: Oh… Mais pourquoi.

msgid: GIA: JES, you silly!\nYou ruined this!
msgstr: Gia: Jes, t’as fait exprès\nde perdre!

msgid: GIA: I can't bear to battle\nwithout my JES!\pDon't you have one more POKéMON?
msgstr: Gia: Je ne peux pas me battre\nsans Jes!\pReviens quand tu auras plus\nde Pokémon.

msgid: There's a lookout spot upstairs.\nThe view is magnificent.
msgstr: Il y a un beau panorama là-haut.

msgid: My POKéMON's ashes are stored in\nPOKéMON TOWER.\pYou can have this TM.\nI don't need it anymore…
msgstr: Les cendres de mes Pokémon sont\ndans la Tour Pokémon.\pTiens! Prends cette CT. Je n’en ai\nplus besoin…

msgid: {PLAYER} received TM27\nfrom the little girl.
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient\nCT27!

msgid: TM27 is a move called RETURN…\pIf you treat your POKéMON good,\nit will return your love by working\lits hardest in battle.
msgstr: La CT27 s’appelle Retour.\pSi tu traites bien tes Pokémon,\nils te le rendront en se donnant\pplus de mal au combat.

msgid: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a man fishing!
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles.\pVous voyez un pêcheur!

msgid: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's POKéMON TOWER!
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles.\pVous voyez la Tour Pokémon!

msgid: My bird POKéMON want to battle\nwith you!
msgstr: Mes Pokémon oiseau cherchent la\nbaston!

msgid: My PIDGEY and PIDGEOTTO combo\nlost?
msgstr: Tu m’as volé dans les plumes!

msgid: My POKéMON look happy even though\nthey lost.
msgstr: Mes Pokémon ont l’air contents,\nmême s’ils ont perdu.

msgid: I'm told I'm good for a kid.
msgstr: Pas mal pour une fille, hein?

msgid: I want to become a good TRAINER.\nI'll train hard, just watch.
msgstr: Je veux être un bon Dresseur.\nJe travaille dur.

msgid: Wow!\nYour BADGES are too cool!
msgstr: Woaa!\nTes Badges sont trop cool!

msgid: Not enough!
msgstr: … J’en ai assez!

msgid: You got those BADGES from GYM\nLEADERS. I know!
msgstr: Tu as gagné ces Badges chez les\nChampions!

msgid: My cute POKéMON wish to make your\nacquaintance.
msgstr: Mes Pokémon tout mignons veulent\nte connaître.

msgid: Good going!\nYou totally won!
msgstr: Wow!\nJ’suis morte!

msgid: You have to make POKéMON battle\nto toughen them up.
msgstr: Tu dois faire combattre tes\nPokémon pour les entraîner!

msgid: I found CARBOS in a cave once\nwhile I was spelunking.
msgstr: J’ai trouvé du Carbone dans une\ngrotte en faisant de la spéléo.

msgid: Oh, too bad!\nI just messed up!
msgstr: J’ai tout raté!

msgid: CARBOS boosted the SPEED of my\nPOKéMON.
msgstr: Le Carbone a augmenté la vitesse\nde mon Pokémon.

msgid: I'm not going to lose.\nNot when the wind's blowing my way!
msgstr: Le vent souffle par là. Cool!

msgid: I'm beat.\nI guess I'll FLY home.
msgstr: J’ai perdu.\nJe rentre chez moi avec Vol.

msgid: Sure, I'll play with you, sweetie.
msgstr: Tu veux te mesurer à moi?

msgid: Oh!\nYou little beast!
msgstr: Oh!\nSale teigne!

msgid: I wonder which is stronger, male or\nfemale POKéMON?
msgstr: C’est quoi le plus fort, un Pokémon\nmâle ou femelle?

msgid: Do you want to battle some\nPOKéMON with me?
msgstr: Et si on se battait?

msgid: It's over already?
msgstr: Fini? Déjà?

msgid: I don't know anything about\nPOKéMON actually.\pThe ones I use… I picked them\nfor their looks!
msgstr: J’y connais rien aux Pokémon!\nJe les trouve juste cool!

msgid: What're you lookin' at?
msgstr: Qu’est-ce que tu regardes, toi!?

msgid: Dang!\nStripped gears!
msgstr: Zipp!\nJ’ai glissé!

msgid: Get lost!
msgstr: Du balai!

msgid: I always go with bird POKéMON.\nI've dedicated myself to them.
msgstr: J’aime bien mes Pokémon oiseau!\nJe leur consacre tout mon temps.

msgid: Out of power!
msgstr: Oh! Ma cage!

msgid: I wish I could fly like PIDGEY and\nPIDGEOTTO…
msgstr: J’aimerais voler comme ROUCOOL ou\nROUCOUPS…

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pLook, look!\nLook to the left of that post!
msgstr: Astuce\pRegardez à gauche!

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pUse SELECT to switch items in the\nITEMS window.
msgstr: Astuce\pUtilisez Select pour organiser\nvotre inventaire!

msgid: ROUTE 13\nNorth to SILENCE BRIDGE
msgstr: Route 13\nPont du Silence au Nord
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Route 13\nNord: Pont Silence

msgid: You need to use TMs to teach good\nmoves to POKéMON.
msgstr: Utilise des CT pour apprendre de\nbonnes attaques à tes Pokémon!

msgid: Not good enough quite yet.
msgstr: … Pas encore assez bon!

msgid: You have some HMs, right? POKéMON\ncan't forget those moves easily.
msgstr: Tu as des CS?\nLes Pokémon ne peuvent pas\lles oublier.

msgid: My bird POKéMON should be ready\nfor battle.
msgstr: Mes Pokémon oiseau veulent\nse battre.

msgid: Not ready yet!
msgstr: … Y veulent plus!

msgid: My bird POKéMON need to learn\nbetter moves.
msgstr: Il leur faut de bonnes attaques.

msgid: They have TMs on sale at the\nCELADON DEPT. STORE.\pTMs aren't really rare, but not\nmany people have HMs.
msgstr: On vend des CT au Centre\nCommercial de Céladopole!\pMais, seuls quelques élus ont\ndes CS!

msgid: Aww, bummer!
msgstr: Ah! Fiasco complet!

msgid: Try teaching POKéMON a move that's\nthe same type as it.\pThat apparently boosts the power\nof the move.
msgstr: Apprends à tes Pokémon des\nattaques de leur type.\pApparemment, ça booste la\npuissance de l’attaque.

msgid: Have you taught your bird POKéMON\nhow to FLY?\pYou'll be able to soar with it into\nthe sky!
msgstr: As-tu appris Vol à tes Pokémon\noiseau?\pGrâce à ça, tu pourras voyager\ndans le ciel sur leur dos.

msgid: Shot down in flames!
msgstr: Ah! Je me suis brûlé les ailes!

msgid: Bird POKéMON are my one true love.\nI don't want to raise anything else.
msgstr: J’adore les Pokémon oiseau,\nje ne m’intéresse qu’à eux!

msgid: Have you heard the legend of the\nwinged mirages?
msgstr: Connais-tu la légende des\nmirages ailés?

msgid: Why?\nWhy'd I lose?
msgstr: Ah?\nJ’ai perdu?
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] … Pourquoi?\nPourquoi je perds encore?

msgid: Well, the winged mirages are the\nlegendary bird POKéMON.\pThere are three of them: ARTICUNO,\nZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.
msgstr: Les mirages ailés seraient les\nPokémon oiseau légendaires.\pIls sont trois: ARTIKODIN,\nELECTHOR et SULFURA.

msgid: I'm not into it, but okay.\nLet's go!
msgstr: J’suis pas d’humeur! Mais bon…

msgid: I knew it!
msgstr: Ben, t’as gagné, non?

msgid: Winning, losing… It's insignificant\nunder this huge sky.
msgstr: Perdre ou gagner, c’est pas le plus\nimportant!

msgid: C'mon, c'mon.\nLet's go, let's go, let's go!
msgstr: Allez, viens! Tu vas voir la tête\nde tes Pokémon!

msgid: Arrg!\nLost! Get lost!
msgstr: Arrg!\nHors de ma vue!

msgid: What, what, what?\nWhat do you want still?
msgstr: Quoi? Quoi?\nTu veux quoi?

msgid: I need to burn some time.\nShut up and battle.
msgstr: Parfait!\nJe m’ennuyais!

msgid: What?\nYou!?
msgstr: Quoi?\nMe faire battre par toi?

msgid: Raising POKéMON is a drag, man.
msgstr: Elever des Pokémon, c’est crevant!

msgid: We ride out here because of the\nwide-open spaces.
msgstr: Y’a plein de place pour les\nbalades ici!

msgid: Wipeout!
msgstr: Balayé!

msgid: It's cool you made your POKéMON so\nstrong.\pMight is right!\nAnd you know it!
msgstr: Cool, tes Pokémon sont super\nbalèzes!\pLa force, c’est important, mais\ntu le sais, non?

msgid: POKéMON battle?\nCool! Rumble!
msgstr: Un combat de Pokémon?\nTremble, minable!

msgid: You know who'd win, you and me\none-on-one!
msgstr: Tu sais que sans tes Pokémon,\nje te pulvérise!

msgid: ROUTE 14\nWest to FUCHSIA CITY
msgstr: Route 14\nParmanie à l’Ouest

msgid: KIRI: JAN, let's try really,\nreally hard together.
msgstr: Joy: Kate, essayons ensemble!

msgid: KIRI: Whimper…\nWe lost, didn't we?
msgstr: Joy: …\nOn a perdu, hein?

msgid: KIRI: Did we lose because of me?
msgstr: Joy: On a perdu à cause de moi?

msgid: KIRI: We can battle if you have\ntwo POKéMON.
msgstr: Joy: On pourra se battre si tu\nviens avec deux Pokémon.

msgid: JAN: KIRI, here we go!\nWe have to try hard!
msgstr: Kate: Allons-y!\nFaisons de notre mieux!

msgid: JAN: Eeeeh!\nNo fair!
msgstr: Kate: Aaaah!\nC’est pas juste!

msgid: JAN: KIRI, don't cry!\nWe'll just try harder next time.
msgstr: Kate: Ne pleure pas Joy!\nOn fera mieux la prochaine fois.

msgid: JAN: You want to battle?\nYou don't have enough POKéMON.
msgstr: Kate: Tu veux te battre?\nMais t’as pas assez de Pokémon!

msgid: I just got some POKéMON in trades.\nCan I try them out on you?
msgstr: Je vais tester les Pokémon que\nj’ai échangés!

msgid: Not good enough!
msgstr: Oh! Perdu!
detail: remplace [relu et corrigé à la main (le patch FR actuel donnait un morceau]

msgid: You can't change the nickname of\nany POKéMON you get in a trade.\pOnly the Original TRAINER can get\nthe nickname changed.
msgstr: Tu ne peux pas renommer un\nPokémon échangé.\pSeul son premier Dresseur\npeut le faire.

msgid: You look gentle, so I think I can\nbeat you.\pI'll give it a go!
msgstr: T’as l’air stupide, je devrais\npouvoir te battre!

msgid: No, wrong!
msgstr: Pas si stupide en fait!

msgid: I'm afraid of BIKERS. They look so\nugly and mean!
msgstr: Les Motards me font peur, ils sont\nsi méchants!

msgid: When I whistle, I can summon bird\nPOKéMON.
msgstr: Je peux appeler des Pokémon\noiseau rien qu’en sifflant!

msgid: Ow!\nThat's tragic!
msgstr: Oh!\nJ’le crois pas!

msgid: Maybe I'm not cut out for battles.\nI'm not the right type, I guess.
msgstr: Je ne suis pas doué pour les\nbastons.

msgid: Hmm? My birds are shivering!\nYou're good, aren't you?
msgstr: Hmm? Mes oiseaux ont peur!\nT’es fortiche, toi?

msgid: This is so obvious, you should know\nthis, but…\pMoves like EARTHQUAKE and FISSURE\nhave no effect on bird POKéMON.
msgstr: Les attaques comme Séisme ou\nAbîme ne font rien aux oiseaux.\pTu l’savais?

msgid: Oh, you're a little cutie!\nSo like a darling POKéMON!
msgstr: Oh! T’es bien jeune, toi!

msgid: You looked so cute, too!
msgstr: T’étais adorable, pourtant!

msgid: I forgive you.\nI can take it.\lI'm a big girl now.
msgstr: Je te pardonne!\nT’es trop adorable!

msgid: I raise POKéMON for protection\nbecause I live alone.
msgstr: J’ai des Pokémon pour me protéger\ncomme je vis toute seule!

msgid: POKéMON isn't about winning or\nlosing for me.
msgstr: Pour moi, les Pokémon ce n’est\npas juste gagner ou perdre.

msgid: I love having my POKéMON greet me\nwhen I get home.\pIt's so reassuring.
msgstr: Je rentre chez moi pour être avec\nmes Pokémon!

msgid: Hey, kid! C'mon!\nI just got these off some loser!
msgstr: Hé, toi!\nRegarde ça!

msgid: Life's too short.\nIt's cool to live as an outlaw.\lTEAM ROCKET RULES!
msgstr: On ne vit qu’une fois! C’est pour\nça que je suis méchant, nyark!

msgid: Fork over all your cash when you\nlose to me, kid!
msgstr: La bourse ou la vie!

msgid: That can't be true!
msgstr: C’est pas possible!

msgid: I was just joking about the money.\nDon't take me all serious.
msgstr: Heu…\nPour l’argent, je plaisantais!

msgid: What's cool and happening?\nTrading POKéMON!
msgstr: Quoi? Echanger des Pokémon\nc’est cool?

msgid: I said trade!
msgstr: Hé! Je parlais d’échanges, pas de\nbastons!

msgid: I trade POKéMON with my friends\nall the time.
msgstr: J’échange des Pokémon avec\nmes amis!

msgid: Want to play with my POKéMON?
msgstr: Je veux me battre avec mes Pokémon!

msgid: I was too impatient!
msgstr: … J’étais trop impatiente!

msgid: I'll go train with weaker people.
msgstr: Je vais me battre avec des\nDresseurs moins forts!

msgid: ROUTE 15\nWest to FUCHSIA CITY
msgstr: Route 15\nParmanie à l’Ouest

msgid: MYA: You're perfect.\nHelp me train my little brother?
msgstr: Mya: On dirait que tu sais\nte battre.\pTu aurais un instant pour qu’on\nentraîne mon petit frère?

msgid: MYA: RON, you have to focus!\nConcentrate on what you're doing!
msgstr: Mya: Ron, tu dois te concentrer!\nPense à ce que tu fais!

msgid: MYA: Okay, we'll turn it up.\nI'll add to our training menu!
msgstr: Mya: OK, il va falloir revoir mon\nprogramme d’entraînement.

msgid: MYA: Do you want to challenge us?\nYou'll need two POKéMON, though.
msgstr: Mya: Tu veux vraiment nous\naffronter?\pEt tu ne sais pas qu’il te faut\ndeux Pokémon pour ça?

msgid: RON: My sister gets scary when we\nlose.
msgstr: Ron: Ma sœur me fait peur quand\non perd.

msgid: RON: Oh, no, no…\nSis, I'm sorry!
msgstr: Ron: Oh non…\nDésolé grande sœur.

msgid: RON: Oh, bleah…\nI wish I had a nice sister…
msgstr: Ron: … Elle me\ntraite comme un gamin.

msgid: RON: Did you want to battle with\nmy sister and me?\pYou need two POKéMON, then.
msgstr: Ron: Tu veux te battre contre nous\ndeux? Avec un seul Pokémon?

msgid: Are you the kid who's working on\na POKéDEX?\pPROF. OAK's AIDE came by here.
msgstr: Tu travailles sur un Pokédex?\pL’assistant du Prof. Chen est\npassé par là.

msgid: EXP. SHARE is an item to be held\nby a POKéMON.\pThe POKéMON will receive a share\nof the EXP. Points without having\lto battle.
msgstr:
Multi Exp est un objet qui
doit être porté par un Pokémon.\pLes Pokémon de ton équipe se
partageront les points d’Exp.\paprès un combat. Même ceux
qui n’ont pas combattu.

msgid: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pA large, shining bird is flying\ntoward the sea.
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles…\pUn grand et bel oiseau vole vers\nla mer.

msgid: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt looks like a small island on\nthe horizon!
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles…\pVous voyez une petite île!

msgid: What do you want?
msgstr: Kess t’as ta?

msgid: Don't you dare laugh!
msgstr: … Galère!

msgid: We like just hanging here.\nWhat's it to you?
msgstr: Nous? On squatte ici…\nEt toi?

msgid: Nice BIKE!\nHand it over!
msgstr: Joli Vélo!\nDonne-le moi!

msgid: Knockout!
msgstr: Tu peux garder ton Vélo!

msgid: Forget it, who needs your BIKE!
msgstr: Je le veux pas ton Vélo!

msgid: Come out and play, little mouse!
msgstr: Viens t’battre! Sale fouine!

msgid: You little rat!
msgstr: Toi!! Espèce de fennec!

msgid: I hate losing!\nGet out of my face!
msgstr: Je déteste perdre…\nSurtout dans ces conditions!

msgid: Hey, you just bumped me!
msgstr: Hé! Tu viens de me rentrer dedans, là?

msgid: We'll always be hanging around here\neven if you don't like it.\pYou can detour to VERMILION from\nFUCHSIA going along the coast.
msgstr: On restera là, que ça te plaise\nou pas!\pTu peux aussi aller de Carmin\nsur Mer à Parmanie par la côte.

msgid: I'm feeling hungry and mean!\nI need a punching bag!
msgstr: J’ai faim, j’suis furax et j’vais\nt’exploser!

msgid: Bad, bad, bad!
msgstr: Grrr! J’suis encore plus furax!

msgid: If I'm going to have POKéMON, they\nmay as well be ferocious.\pI'd use them to leave my enemies\nin tatters.
msgstr: Mes Pokémon sont féroces!\nIls déchirent mes ennemis!

msgid: Hey, there!\nLet's have ourselves a good time!
msgstr: BASTOONNNN!

msgid: Don't make me mad!
msgstr: Bah! M’énerve pas!

msgid: I get my kicks by harassing people\nwith my stinking POKéMON.\pThey're great for startling people.\nAnd, they bite, too.
msgstr: Je terrorise mes adversaires avec\nmes Pokémon super vicieux!\pIls sont super pour faire flipper.\nEt en plus ils mordent!

msgid: Enjoy the slope!\nCYCLING ROAD
msgstr: Bonne descente!\nPiste Cyclable
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Une descente d’enfer!\nPiste Cyclable

msgid: JED: Our love knows no bounds.\nWe're in love and we show it!
msgstr: Ali: Notre amour n’a pas de limite.\nOn s’aime et on le montre!

msgid: JED: Oh, no!\nMy love has seen me as a loser!
msgstr: Ali: Noon, mon amour va me\nprendre pour un perdant.

msgid: JED: Listen, LEA.\nYou need to focus less on me.
msgstr: Ali: Ecoute Lise, c’est au combat\nque tu dois penser, pas à moi.

msgid: JED: You have just one POKéMON?\nIs there no love in your heart?
msgstr: Ali: Tu n’as qu’un Pokémon?\pN’y a-t-il pas de place dans\nton cœur?

msgid: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of\nour love scares me.
msgstr: Lise: Je suis parfois effrayée par\nla force de notre amour.

msgid: LEA: Ohh! But JED looks cool\neven in a loss!
msgstr: Lise: Mais je le trouve beau même\nquand il perd.

msgid: LEA: Ehehe, I'm sorry.\nJED is so cool.
msgstr: Lise: Je suis désolée.\nJe pensais à Ali.

msgid: LEA: Oh, you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you?\pDoesn't it feel lonely for you or\nyour POKéMON?
msgstr: Lise: Tu n’as qu’un Pokémon?\pTu n’as pas peur qu’il se sente\nun peu seul?

msgid: Oh, dear.\nYou've found my secret retreat.\pPlease don't tell anyone I'm here.\nI'll make it up to you with this!
msgstr: Oh!\nTu as trouvé ma cache secrète!\pPrends ceci. En échange, ne dis\nà personne que tu m’as vue!

msgid: {PLAYER} received HM02\nfrom the girl.
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient la\nCS02!

msgid: HM02 is FLY.\nIt's a wonderfully convenient move.\pPlease, put it to good use.
msgstr: CS02: Vol. C’est une capacité\ntrès pratique.\pFais-en bon usage!

msgid: You don't have any room for this.
msgstr: Ton inventaire est plein.
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Tu n’as plus de place pour ça.

msgid: FEAROW: Kyueen!
msgstr: RAPASDEPIC: Piiiiiik!

msgid: No pedestrians are allowed on\nCYCLING ROAD!
msgstr: Interdit aux piétons!\nPiste Cyclable!

msgid: CYCLING ROAD is a downhill course\nby the sea. It's a great ride.
msgstr: La Piste Cyclable est une superbe\nroute menant à la mer.

msgid: Excuse me!\nWait up, please!
msgstr: Pardon!\nHé, pardon!

msgid: How'd you get in?\nGood effort!
msgstr: Comment t’as fait pour arriver\njusqu’ici?

msgid: I'm on a relaxing ride on my new\nbike with my girlfriend.
msgstr: Je vais me faire une virée avec ma\np’tite copine!

msgid: We're going riding together on our\nnew bikes.
msgstr: On va pédaler ensemble!

msgid: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pIt's the CELADON DEPT. STORE!
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles…\pVous voyez le Centre Commercial\nde Céladopole!

msgid: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere's a long path over water far\naway.
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles…\pVous voyez un grand ponton!

msgid:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on 40 species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with an
AMULET COIN for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
40 kinds of POKéMON?
msgstr:
Salut! Tu te rappelles?
Je suis un assistant du Prof. Chen!\pSi tu attrapes 40 Pokémon
différents, je suis censé\lt’offrir cette Pièce Rune!\pAlors {PLAYER}, as-tu attrapé au
moins 40 Pokémon différents?

msgid: {PLAYER} received the AMULET COIN\nfrom the AIDE.
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient une\nPièce Rune!

msgid: An AMULET COIN is an item to be\nheld by a POKéMON.\pIf the POKéMON appears in a winning\nbattle, you will earn more money.
msgstr: Une Pièce Rune doit être tenue\npar un Pokémon.\pSi ce Pokémon apparaît dans une\nvictoire, tu reçois plus d’argent.

msgid: There's no getting rich quick in\nbattling kids.
msgstr: Pff… Un gosse, ça n’a jamais\nd’flouze!

msgid: Burned out!
msgstr: Nan!!! Mon carbure!

msgid: You can find good stuff lying\naround on CYCLING ROAD.\pThere's good money in picking them\nup and selling them.
msgstr: Y a plein de trucs qui traînent\nsur la Piste Cyclable!

msgid: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo.\nCome on!
msgstr: Kess tu veux, toi l’mioche?

msgid: I could belly-bump you outta\nhere!
msgstr: Je vais t’éjecter d’ici à coup de\nclaques!

msgid: I love racing downhill!
msgstr: J’aime pédaler comme un dingue!\nUn giga-dingue!

msgid: We're BIKERS!\nWe rule the roads, man!
msgstr: On est des Motards!\nDes vrais, des purs, des durs,\ldes méchants… Et tout et tout!

msgid: Smoked!
msgstr: Nyargh! J’ai crevé une roue!

msgid: Let VOLTORB electrify you!
msgstr: Mes VOLTORBE vont t’électrocuter!

msgid: Grounded out!
msgstr: Arglagh! J’me suis fait électrocuter!

msgid: I got my VOLTORB at the abandoned\nPOWER PLANT.
msgstr: J’ai attrapé un VOLTORBE dans la\nCentrale.

msgid: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it\nwon't evolve. Why?
msgstr: Hein? Faire évoluer mes Pokémon?\nBen pourquoi?

msgid: Why, you!
msgstr: Ha… OK, OK!

msgid: Maybe some POKéMON need element\nSTONES to evolve.
msgstr: Certains Pokémon ont besoin d’une\nPierre pour évoluer.

msgid: Whew!\nGood workout!
msgstr: Pfou!\nJ’suis épuisé!

msgid: I'm sure I lost weight there!
msgstr: Cool! J’ai perdu du poids!

msgid: Be a rebel!
msgstr: No future!

msgid: Be ready to fight for your beliefs!
msgstr: Prépare-toi à la baston, microbe!

msgid: Nice BIKE!\nHow's it handle?
msgstr: Mignon le Vélo!\nComment ça se conduit?

msgid: Shoot!
msgstr: Pan! Dans les dents!

msgid: The slope makes it hard to steer.
msgstr: La pente rend la conduite difficile!

msgid: Get lost, kid!\nI'm bushed!
msgstr: Du vent toi!\nJ’suis épuisé!

msgid: Are you satisfied?
msgstr: Voilà, ça te va?

msgid: I need to catch a few z's!
msgstr: Je vais aller piquer un somme!

msgid: It's a notice.\pWatch out for discarded items.
msgstr: Un conseil!\pAttention de ne pas jeter un objet\nimportant!

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON are unique.\pEven POKéMON of the same species\nand level grow at different rates.
msgstr: Astuce\pChaque Pokémon est unique.\pDes Pokémon de même type et de\nmême niveau évoluent différemment.

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pPress the B Button to stay in place\nwhile on a slope.
msgstr: Astuce\pAppuyez sur le bouton B pour\nvous arrêter dans une descente.

msgid: It's a notice!\pDon't throw the game, throw POKé\nBALLS instead!
msgstr: Un conseil!\pNe jetez pas la console, jetez\nplutôt des Poké Balls.

msgid: You need a BICYCLE to go out on\nCYCLING ROAD!
msgstr: Il faut une Bicyclette pour aller\nsur la Piste Cyclable!

msgid: CYCLING ROAD is all uphill from\nhere.
msgstr: La descente de la Piste Cyclable\ncommence ici.

msgid: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pPALLET TOWN is in the west.
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles.\pBourg Palette est à l’Ouest!

msgid: Let's see what the binoculars have\nto show…\pThere are people swimming.
msgstr: Vous regardez dans les jumelles…\pC’est plein de nageurs!

msgid: I always check every grassy area\nfor new POKéMON.
msgstr: Je fouille les hautes herbes pour\ny trouver des Pokémon.

msgid: Tch!
msgstr: Oh!

msgid: I wish I had a BIKE!
msgstr: Ah, si j’avais un Vélo!

msgid: Kurukkoo!\nHow do you like my birdcall?
msgstr: Cui cui cui!\nJ’fais l’oiseau, ça ressemble?

msgid: I had to bug you!
msgstr: … J’suis cuit!

msgid: I collect sea POKéMON on weekends\nbecause the sea is so close.
msgstr: Le week-end, je collectionne les\nPokémon Eau!

msgid: This is my turf!\nGet out of here!
msgstr: T’es sur mon gazon, dégage!

msgid: This is my fave area for catching\nPOKéMON.
msgstr: C’est mon endroit préféré pour\nchasser les Pokémon!

msgid: CYCLING ROAD\nNo pedestrians permitted!
msgstr: Piste Cyclable\nInterdite aux piétons!

msgid: I have to exercise and warm up\nbefore going out for a swim.
msgstr: Je m’échauffe avant de piquer\nune tête!

msgid: All warmed up!
msgstr: J’suis tout chaud, là!

msgid: Thanks, kid!\nI'm ready for a swim.
