msgstr: OK, prêt à plonger!

msgid: Wait! Slow down!\nYou'll have a heart attack!
msgstr: Attends! Mouille-toi la nuque avant\nde plonger!

msgid: Ooh!\nThat's chilly!
msgstr: Ha! J’suis bien refroidi, là!

msgid: Watch out for TENTACOOL.\nThey sting so painfully.
msgstr: Fais gaffe aux TENTACOOL!

msgid: I love swimming!\nWhat about you?
msgstr: J’aime nager!\nEt toi?

msgid: Belly flop!
msgstr: Plaouff! T’es dans la vague!

msgid: I can beat even marine POKéMON\nat swimming.
msgstr: Je nage plus vite que les Pokémon!

msgid: What's beyond the horizon?
msgstr: D’où vient le vent?

msgid: I see a couple of islands over\nyonder!
msgstr: Je vois des îles au loin!

msgid: I tried diving for POKéMON, but it\nwas a no-go.
msgstr: Je cherche des Pokémon dans les\ngrands fonds!

msgid: I guess you have to fish for sea\nPOKéMON.
msgstr: C’est en pêchant que tu attraperas\ndes Pokémon Eau!

msgid: I look at the sea to forget all\nthe bad things that happened.
msgstr: La mer, l’écume, les vagues…\nC’est beau!!!

msgid: Ooh!\nTraumatic!
msgstr: Aïe!\nT’es pas poète!

msgid: I'm looking at the sea to forget\nthe bad thing that happened!
msgstr: Je cherche la paix intérieure dans\nla mer!

msgid: Oh, I just love your ride!\nCan I have it if I win?
msgstr: Ah, j’en ai marre de nager!

msgid: It's still a long way to go to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS…\pI want to go back to FUCHSIA…
msgstr: C’est vraiment loin les\nIles Ecume!\pJe vais retourner à Parmanie.

msgid: Swimming's great!\nSunburns aren't!
msgstr: Nager c’est cool!\nFaut juste éviter de couler!

msgid: Shocker!
msgstr: Plaouff!

msgid: My boyfriend wanted to swim to\nSEAFOAM ISLANDS.
msgstr: Mon p’tit copain veut nager\njusqu’aux Iles Ecume.

msgid: Ahoy, there!\nThese waters are treacherous!
msgstr: Ces eaux sont dangereuses!

msgid: Ooh!\nDangerous!
msgstr: Argh!\nDangereux!

msgid: M-my legs! They cramped up!\nGlub, glub…
msgstr: J’ai une crampe!\nGloup! Argl!

msgid: I swam here with my friends…\nI'm tired…
msgstr: Je nage, mais j’en ai marre!

msgid: I'm exhausted…
msgstr: J’en peux plus…

msgid: If I were to ride a POKéMON on\nthe sea, I'd like a LAPRAS.\pLAPRAS is so big, I bet it\nwould keep me dry on water.
msgstr: Un LOKHLASS, c’est grand et gros!\pSi je montes sur son dos,\nje ne serai pas mouillée!

msgid: SEA ROUTE 19\nFUCHSIA CITY - SEAFOAM ISLANDS
msgstr: Route 19\nParmanie - Iles Ecume

msgid: LIA: I'm looking after my brother.\nHe just became a TRAINER.
msgstr: VIVI: Je recherche mon frère.\nIl vient de devenir Dresseur.

msgid: LIA: That's no way to treat my\nlittle brother!
msgstr: VIVI: C’est pas une façon de\ntraiter mon petit frère!

msgid: LIA: Do you have a younger\nbrother?\pI hope you're teaching him all\nsorts of things.
msgstr: VIVI: Tu as un petit frère toi\naussi?\pJ’espère que tu lui apprends tout\nplein de trucs.

msgid: LIA: I want to battle together\nwith my little brother.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?
msgstr: VIVI: Je veux me battre aux côtés\nde mon frère.\pBah, t’as pas deux Pokémon?

msgid: LUC: My big sis taught me how\nto swim and train POKéMON.
msgstr: Sam: Ma grande sœur m’a tout\nappris sur les Pokémon.

msgid: LUC: Oh, wow!\nSomeone tougher than my big sis!
msgstr: Sam: Oh, wow! J’ai trouvé quelqu’un\nde plus fort que ma sœur.

msgid: LUC: My big sis is strong and nice.\nI think she's awesome!
msgstr: Sam: Ma grande sœur est balèze\net sympa. Je l’adore.

msgid: LUC: I don't want to if I can't\nbattle you with my big sis.\pDon't you have two POKéMON?
msgstr: Sam: On s’battra que si j’suis\navec ma sœur.\pT’as pas deux Pokémon?

msgid:
Hi!
I work at a POKéMON MART.\pIt's part of a convenient chain
selling all sorts of items.\pPlease, visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.\pI know, I'll give you a sample.
Here you go!
msgstr:
Salut! Je travaille à la
Boutique Pokémon.\pNous avons plein d’articles! Viens
nous voir à Jadielle.\pPrends donc ceci comme
échantillon!

msgid: Please come see us if you need\nPOKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.
msgstr: Nous avons aussi des Poké Balls\npour capturer les Pokémon!

msgid: {PLAYER} put the POTION away in\nthe BAG's ITEMS POCKET.
msgstr: {PLAYER} range la Potion dans la\nPoche Objets du Sac.

msgid: See those ledges along the road?\pIt's a bit scary, but you can jump\nfrom them.\pYou can get back to PALLET TOWN\nquicker that way.
msgstr: Tu vois tous ces petits talus?\pTu peux sauter par-dessus!\nC’est dingue, non?\pTu peux revenir plus vite à\nBourg Palette de cette façon!

msgid: The water is shallow here.\nThere are many people swimming.
msgstr: La mer est peu profonde ici,\nn’est-ce pas?

msgid: I wish I could ride my POKéMON.\nI bet you're not tired.
msgstr: Ah, si je pouvais monter sur mes\nPokémon.

msgid: SEAFOAM is a quiet getaway.\nI'm vacationing here.
msgstr: Les Iles Ecume sont tranquilles!

msgid: Quit it!
msgstr: Nyann!

msgid: There's a huge cavern underneath\nthis island.
msgstr: Il y a une grande caverne sous\ncette île.

msgid: I love floating with the fishes\nhere among the waves.
msgstr: J’aime faire la planche avec les\npoissons!

msgid: Yowch!
msgstr: Glargh!

msgid: Want to float with me?
msgstr: Tu veux nager avec moi?

msgid: Are you on vacation, too?
msgstr: T’es en vacances toi aussi?

msgid: No mercy at all!
msgstr: Non! Pas de pitié!

msgid: SEAFOAM used to be a single island\nin the distant past.
msgstr: Avant, ben, les Iles Ecumes ne\nformaient qu’une seule île!

msgid: Check out my buff physique!
msgstr: Mate un peu mon corps de rêve!\nC’est beau hein?

msgid: Wimpy!
msgstr: Aïeu!

msgid: I should've been buffing up my\nPOKéMON, not me!
msgstr: J’aurais dû entraîner un peu\nplus mes Pokémon!

msgid: Why are you riding a POKéMON?\nCan't you swim?
msgstr: Ben, t’es sur un Pokémon, tu sais\npas nager?

msgid: Ouch!\nTorpedoed!
msgstr: Ouch!\nJe coule!

msgid: Riding a POKéMON sure looks fun!
msgstr: Surfer sur un Pokémon, c’est cool!

msgid: I rode my bird POKéMON here.
msgstr: Mes Pokémon oiseau m’ont déposé ici!

msgid: Oh, no!\nNow what am I to do?
msgstr: Oh!\nNOoOoOon!

msgid: My birds are exhausted.\nThey can't FLY me back!
msgstr: Mes oiseaux sont trop fatigués\npour utiliser Vol!

msgid: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.
msgstr: Mon p’tit copain m’a offert des\nperles sublimes!

msgid: Oh, no!\nMy pearls were in them!
msgstr: Non!\nMes perles étaient dedans!

msgid: Will my pearls grow bigger inside\nCLOYSTER?
msgstr: Et si je mettais mes perles dans un\nCRUSTABRI?

msgid: I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND.\nIt wasn't easy, I tell you.
msgstr: J’ai nagé depuis Cramois’Ile!

msgid: I'm so disappointed!
msgstr: J’ai bu la tasse!

msgid: POKéMON have taken over an\nabandoned mansion on CINNABAR.\pThey call it the POKéMON MANSION\nnow.
msgstr: Des Pokémon infestent un vieux\nmanoir de Cramois’Ile!\pOn l’appelle le Manoir Pokémon.

msgid: CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB\nfor POKéMON.\pMy daddy works there.
msgstr: Il y a un Labo Pokémon à\nCramois’Ile.

msgid: Wait!\nYou're supposed to wait!
msgstr: Attends!

msgid: CINNABAR is a volcanic island.\pI heard it rose out of the sea\nwhen a volcano erupted.
msgstr: Cramois’Ile est une île\nvolcanique!

msgid: Strong TRAINERS and WATER POKéMON\nare common sights in these parts.\pThey say that MISTY of the\nCERULEAN GYM trains here.
msgstr: On voit souvent des Dresseurs\navec des Pokémon Eau par ici.\pIls disent qu’Ondine de l’Arène\nd’Azuria s’entraîne dans le coin.

msgid: You want to know if the fish are\nbiting?
msgstr: Tu veux savoir s’il y a des\npoissons ici?

msgid: I can't catch anything good.\nNot one good POKéMON to be had!
msgstr: Y’a comme un manque de poisson!

msgid: I got a big haul!\nWanna go for it?
msgstr: J’ai eu une bonne prise!\nTu veux tester?

msgid: Heheh, MAGIKARP just don't make\nthe grade, do they?
msgstr: Zut!\nEncore un MAGICARPE!

msgid: I seem to only catch MAGIKARP!
msgstr: Je ne pêche que des MAGICARPE!

msgid: The sea cleanses my body and soul!
msgstr: Ah, je suis revigoré par l’écume.

msgid: The sea is great and all, but I\nlike the mountains, too.
msgstr: J’adore la mer mais j’ai rien\ncontre la montagne!

msgid: I caught my POKéMON at sea.
msgstr: J’ai attrapé tous mes Pokémon\ndans l’eau!

msgid: Diver!!\nDown!!
msgstr: Splash!

msgid: Where'd you catch your POKéMON?
msgstr: Mais où as-tu attrapé autant de\nPokémon?

msgid: Right now, I'm in a triathlon meet.
msgstr: Hop là! J’suis en plein triathlon!

msgid: Pant…\nPant… Pant…
msgstr: Nyan…\nJ’ai perdu le rythme…

msgid: I'm beat! But, I still have the\nbike race and marathon left!
msgstr: Tu m’as battu! Mais le marathon\na pas encore commencé!

msgid: Ahh!\nFeel the sun and the wind!
msgstr: Ah! Le ciel, le soleil et la mer!

msgid: Yow!\nI lost!
msgstr: Woh!\nJ’ai perdu!

msgid: I'm sunburnt to a crisp!
msgstr: J’ai des coups de soleil!

msgid: Hey, don't scare away the fish!
msgstr: Va-t-en, tu m’fais peur!

msgid: Sorry! I'm just so frustrated from\nnot catching anything.
msgstr: Heu!\nJ’le ferai plus!

msgid: Sheesh, I haven't caught a thing.\nCould this place actually be a\lgiant pool or something?
msgstr: J’étais énervé de n’avoir rien\nattrapé.

msgid: Keep me company till I get a hit.
msgstr: Reste donc avec moi, le temps\nd’avoir une touche!

msgid: That burned some time.
msgstr: Argh! Perte de temps!

msgid: Oh wait!\nI got a bite! Yeah!
msgstr: Attends!\nJ’ai une touche!

msgid: LIL: Huh? A battle?\nIAN, can't you do it alone?
msgstr: Ly: Hein? Tu veux te battre?\nIan, on y va!

msgid: LIL: Oh, see?\nWe lost. Happy now?
msgstr: Ly: Oh, tu vois? On a perdu!\nT’es content?

msgid: LIL: I'm tired.\nCan't we go home already?
msgstr: Ly: j’suis épuisée. On va rentrer\nà la maison.

msgid: LIL: Huh? A battle?\nI can't be bothered to do it alone.\lBring two POKéMON, won't you?
msgstr: Ly: Hein? Tu veux te battre?\pJe me bats qu’avec mon frère.\nReviens avec deux Pokémon.

msgid: IAN: My sis doesn't get enough\nexercise, so I made her come.
msgstr: Ian: Je coache ma sœur pour \nqu’elle fasse du sport.

msgid: IAN: Awww, Sis!\nGet it together!
msgstr: Ian: Aaaah. Il va falloir\ns’entraîner un peu plus.

msgid: IAN: Come on, Sis!\pYou're not going to lose weight\nlike this!
msgstr: Ian: Allez sœurette! C’est pas\ncomme ça que tu vas maigrir!

msgid: IAN: We want a two-on-two battle.\nSo can you bring two POKéMON?
msgstr: Ian: On veut se battre en combat\ndeux contre deux.\pAlors reviens avec deux Pokémon.

msgid:
{RIVAL}: Hey! {PLAYER}!\pYou're off to the POKéMON LEAGUE?
Forget about it!\pYou probably don't have any
BADGES, do you?\pThe guard won't let you through
without them.\pBy the way, did your POKéMON get
any stronger?
msgstr:
{RIVAL}: Hé! {PLAYER}!\pTu vas à la Ligue Pokémon?
Laisse tomber!\pT’es bien trop minable. En plus il
te faut des Badges!\pLes gardes ne te laisseront
jamais passer!\pAu fait, ça se passe comment
l’entraînement de tes Pokémon?

msgid: Awww!\nYou just lucked out!
msgstr: Haha! C’est la chance des\ndébutants!

msgid:
I heard the POKéMON LEAGUE is
crawling with tough TRAINERS.\pI have to figure out how to get
past them.\pYou should quit dawdling and get a
move on!
msgstr:
Il paraît qu’il y a des super
Dresseurs dans la Ligue Pokémon!\pJe dois trouver un moyen de
les battre!\pTu devrais t’y mettre sérieusement
si tu veux les battre!

msgid: What!?\pI was just careless, you!
msgstr: Quoi!?\pJe pensais juste à autre chose!

msgid: That loosened me up.\nI'm ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE!\p{PLAYER}, you need more practice.\pBut hey, you know that!\nI'm out of here. Smell ya!
msgstr:
C’était un bon échauffement!
J’suis prêt pour la Ligue Pokémon!\p{PLAYER}, faut vraiment que tu
t’entraînes plus!\pMais je crois que tu commences à
le savoir. Tchao!

msgid: VICTORY ROAD GATE -\nPOKéMON LEAGUE
msgstr: Route Victoire\n- Ligue Pokémon

msgid: Congratulations! You beat our\nfive contest TRAINERS!\pYou just earned a fabulous prize!
msgstr: Félicitations!\nTu as battu les 5 Dresseurs!\pTu as gagné un fabuleux prix!

msgid: {PLAYER} received a NUGGET\nfrom the mystery TRAINER!
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient:\nPépite!

msgid: You don't have any room!
msgstr: Ton inventaire est plein!

msgid:
By the way, how would you like to
join TEAM ROCKET?\pWe're a group of professional
criminals specializing in POKéMON!\pWant to join?\pAre you sure?\pCome on, join us!\pI'm telling you to join!\p…Okay, you need convincing!\pI'll make you an offer you can't
refuse!
msgstr:
Veux-tu rejoindre les rangs de la
Team Rocket?\pNous sommes un groupe de
criminels spécialisés en Pokémon!\pÇa t’intéresse?\pVraiment?\pAllez, viens!\pBon, je t’ai dit de venir avec
nous!\pJe vois…\pJe vais devoir me montrer plus
persuasif!

msgid: Arrgh!\nYou are good!
msgstr: Arrgh!\nPas mal!

msgid: With your ability, you'd become\na top leader in TEAM ROCKET.\pCome on, think of the opportunity!\nDon't let this chance go to waste.
msgstr: Tu pourrais vite devenir un chef\nau sein de la Team Rocket!\pAllez, je te laisse y penser, ne\nlaisse pas passer cette chance.

msgid: I saw your feat from the grass!
msgstr: Je suis au courant de tes exploits!

msgid: I thought not!
msgstr: Oh, je pensais avoir une chance.

msgid: I hid because the people on the\nbridge frightened me.
msgstr: Je me cache, les gens sur le pont\nme font peur!

msgid: Okay! I'm No. 5!\nI'll stomp you!
msgstr: OK! J’suis le numéro 5!\nJe vais t’écraser!

msgid: I did my best, so I've no regrets!
msgstr: J’ai participé, et j’ai perdu!
detail: remplace [relu et corrigé à la main]

msgid: People call this the NUGGET\nBRIDGE!\pBeat us five TRAINERS and win\na fabulous prize!\pThink you got what it takes?
msgstr: Voici le Pont Pépite!\n5 Dresseurs le défendent!\pBats-les tous pour remporter\nun prix fabuleux!\pTu crois pouvoir y arriver?

msgid: Local TRAINERS come here to\npractice.
msgstr: Les Dresseurs du coin viennent\nici pour s’entraîner!

msgid: You're decent.
msgstr: Bien joué.

msgid: All POKéMON have weaknesses.\nEven the strongest ones.\pThat's why it's best to raise\nPOKéMON of different types.
msgstr: Tous les Pokémon ont des\nfaiblesses, même les plus forts.\pIl vaut donc mieux dresser des\nPokémon de types différents.

msgid: Dad took me to a great party on\nthe S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.
msgstr: Je suis allé à une super fête.\nC’était sur L’Océane, à\lCarmin sur Mer!

msgid: I'm not mad!
msgstr: Yaha! J’suis pas fou!

msgid: On the S.S. ANNE, I saw TRAINERS\nfrom around the world.
msgstr: Sur L’Océane, j’ai vu des\nDresseurs du monde entier.

msgid: I'm a cool guy.\nI've got a girlfriend!
msgstr: J’suis cool.\nEt j’ai une copine aussi!

msgid: Aww, darn…
msgstr: Zut! Zut, zut et zut!

msgid: Oh, well.\nMy girlfriend will cheer me up.
msgstr: Ma copine va m’encourager.

msgid: Hi!\nMy boyfriend is cool!
msgstr: Mon p’tit copain, c’est le plus\nbeau de tous!

msgid: My conditioning isn't the best…
msgstr: Hmm… Je ne suis pas au top!

msgid: I wish my boyfriend was as good\nas you.
msgstr: J’aimerais que mon copain\nsoit aussi fort que toi!

msgid: I had this feeling…\nI knew I had to battle you!
msgstr: Y’a un Dresseur de trop ici!

msgid: I knew I'd lose, too!
msgstr: Ben… Je me sens de trop!

msgid: If your POKéMON gets confused,\nswitch it out.\pThat's a good tactic.
msgstr: Si ton Pokémon est confus,\nrappelle-le!\pC’est une bonne tactique.

msgid: My friend has many cute POKéMON.\nI'm so jealous!
msgstr: Mon copain a des Pokémon trognons!\nJe suis jalouse!

msgid: I'm not so jealous!
msgstr: Je ne suis pas si jalouse.

msgid: You came from MT. MOON?\nMay I have a CLEFAIRY?
msgstr: Tu viens du Mont Sélénite?\nTu as un MELOFEE?

msgid: I just got down from MT. MOON,\nbut I've still got gas in the tank!
msgstr: J’arrive du Mont Sélénite, et je\nsuis prêt!

msgid: You worked hard!
msgstr: Pfiou! T’as dû travailler dur!

msgid: Drat!\nA ZUBAT bit me back in that cave.
msgstr: Aaaaaaargh! Je me suis fait mordre\npar un NOSFERAPTI.

msgid: I'm off to see a POKéMANIAC's\ncollection at the cape.
msgstr: Je cherche le collectionneur de\nPokémon!

msgid: You done got me, and real good,\ntoo!
msgstr: Heu! Tu m’as eu!\nEt facilement en plus.

msgid: The POKéMANIAC sure lives up to\nhis name.\pHis collection includes many rare\nspecies of POKéMON.
msgstr: Le collectionneur a plein de\nPokémon rares.

msgid: You're going to see BILL?\nFirst, we battle!
msgstr: Tu vas voir Léo?\nOk, mais d’abord, BASTOONNN!

msgid: You're something.
msgstr: Perdu!

msgid: The trail below is a shortcut to\nCERULEAN CITY.
msgstr: La route, en bas, est un raccourci\nvers Azuria.

msgid: SEA COTTAGE\nBILL lives here!
msgstr: Villa\nLéo habite ici!
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Villa du Cap\nChez Léo!

msgid: This cape is a famous date spot.\pMISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high\nhopes about this place.
msgstr: Ce cap sert souvent de\npoint de rencontre aux amoureux.\pOn dit qu’Ondine y aurait de\ngrands espoirs.

msgid: Hello, are you here alone?\pIf you're out at CERULEAN's cape…\nWell, it should be as a couple.
msgstr: Salut, y’a personne avec toi? \pSi tu viens au cap d’Azuria, autant\nque ce soit avec quelqu’un.

msgid:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, pal.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!
msgstr:
Yah! Je suis un Pokémon…
…\lHeu, en fait non!\pAppelle-moi Léo!
Je suis un vrai Pokémaniac!\lTu ne me crois pas?\pMais c’est vrai!
J’ai raté une expérience et me\lvoilà changé en Pokémon!\pTu me crois maintenant?
Tu m’aides alors?

msgid:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON…
…No I'm not!\pCall me BILL!
I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!\pHey!
What's with that skeptical look?\pI'm not joshing you, lady.\pI screwed up an experiment and got
combined with a POKéMON!\pSo, how about it?
Help me out here!
msgstr:
Yah! Je suis un Pokémon…
…\lHeu, en fait non!\pAppelle-moi Léo!
Je suis un vrai Pokémaniac!\lTu ne me crois pas?\pMais c’est vrai!
J’ai raté une expérience et me\lvoilà changé en Pokémon!\pTu me crois maintenant?
Tu m’aides alors?

msgid: Wait till I get inside the\nTELEPORTER.\pWhen I do, go to my PC and run\nthe Cell Separation System.
msgstr: Je vais dans le Téléporteur.\pAttends que je sois dedans et\nlance le programme sur mon PC!

msgid:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, chief?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!
msgstr:
Non!? Hé, mais tu dois m’aider, je
suis un mec cool!\pBon, allez!
S’te plaît!\pOK?
Tant pis!

msgid:
No!?
Now don't be so cold!\pCome on, you gotta help a guy in
deep, deep trouble!\pWhat do you say, beautiful?
Please?\lOkay?\lAll right!
msgstr:
Non!? Hé, mais tu dois m’aider,
sois pas cruelle!\pBon, allez!
S’te plaît!\pOK?
Tant pis!

msgid:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, bud! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.
msgstr:
Léo: Yahou!
Merci, mec! Je t’en dois une!\pBon, tu es venu pour voir ma
collection de Pokémon?\pNon?
Tu rigoles!\pBon, ben, prends ça en
remerciement!

msgid:
BILL: Yeehah!
Thanks, lady! I owe you one!\pSo, did you come to see my
POKéMON collection?\pYou didn't?
That's a bummer.\pI've got to thank you…
Oh, here, maybe this'll do.
msgstr:
Léo: Yahou!
Merci, ma belle! Je t’en dois une!\pBon, tu es venue pour voir ma
collection de Pokémon?\pNon?
Tu rigoles!\pBon, ben, prends ça en
remerciement!

msgid: {PLAYER} received an S.S. TICKET\nfrom BILL.
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient le\nPasse Bateau!

msgid: You've got too much stuff!
msgstr: Ton inventaire est plein!

msgid:
That cruise ship S.S. ANNE is in
VERMILION CITY.\pI hear there are lots of TRAINERS
on board, too.\pThey invited me to their party, but
I can't stand fancy do's.\pWhy don't you go instead of me?
Go on and have a good time.
msgstr: L’Océane est à Carmin sur Mer.\nLes passagers sont des Dresseurs!\pJe suis invité à leur fête mais je\nne supporte pas ces mariolles!\pVas-y à ma place.

msgid: BILL: Feel like checking out some\nof my rare POKéMON on my PC?\pGo on, check out my PC.
msgstr: Léo: N’hésite pas à regarder mes\nPokémon sur mon PC.\pJ’en ai de très rares!

msgid: TELEPORTER is displayed on the PC\nmonitor.
msgstr: Le Téléporteur est affiché\nsur le moniteur du PC!

msgid: {PLAYER} initiated the TELEPORTER's\nCell Separator.
msgstr: {PLAYER} enclenche le Téléporteur!

msgid: BILL's favorite POKéMON list!
msgstr: La liste des Pokémon favoris de Léo!

msgid: Which POKéMON do you want to see?
msgstr: Quel Pokémon voulez-vous voir?

msgid:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.\pIf your POKéDEX has complete data
on ten species, I'm supposed to\lgive you a reward.\pPROF. OAK entrusted me with
HM05 for you.\pSo, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.\pHave you gathered data on at least
ten kinds of POKéMON?
msgstr:
Salut! Tu te rappelles de moi?
Je suis un assistant du Prof. Chen!\pSi tu attrapes dix Pokémon
différents, je suis censé t’offrir…\pcette CS05!\pAlors {PLAYER}, as-tu attrapé au
moins dix Pokémon différents?

msgid: {PLAYER} received HM05\nfrom the AIDE.
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient\nCS05!

msgid: HM05 contains the hidden move\nFLASH.\pFLASH lights up even the darkest\nof caves and dungeons.
msgstr: La CS Flash peut éclairer les\nendroits sombres.

msgid: Once a POKéMON learns FLASH, you\ncan get through ROCK TUNNEL.
msgstr: Si un Pokémon a appris Flash,\ntu pourras traverser la Grotte.

msgid: A fainted POKéMON just has no\nenergy left to battle.\pIt can still use moves like CUT\noutside of battle.
msgstr: Un Pokémon KO ne peut se battre\nmais il peut encore utiliser des\ltechniques comme Coupe!

msgid: Many POKéMON live only in forests \nand caves.\pYou need to be persistent and look\neverywhere to get different kinds.
msgstr: De nombreux Pokémon vivent\nuniquement dans les forêts ou les\lcavernes.\pCherche bien partout pour tous\nles attraper!

msgid: Have you noticed the skinny trees\non the roadside?\pThey can be cut down by a special\nPOKéMON move, I hear.
msgstr: As-tu remarqué les buissons sur la\nroute?\pUne technique secrète de Pokémon\npeut les couper.

msgid:
Do you know the evolution-cancel
technique?\pWhen a POKéMON is evolving, you
can stop the process.\pIt's a technique for raising
POKéMON the way they are.
msgstr:
Tu peux empêcher un Pokémon
d’évoluer.\pQuand un Pokémon évolue, tu peux
stopper le processus.\pC’est une technique pour qu’ils
restent comme ils sont.

msgid: Are you going to VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nIt's a natural maze in there.\lBe careful you don't get lost.
msgstr: Vas-tu dans la Forêt de Jade?\nFais bien attention de ne pas te\lperdre, c’est un vrai labyrinthe!

msgid: RATTATA may be small, but don't\nunderestimate its wicked bite.\pHave you caught one already?
msgstr: RATTATA est petit mais il est\nsournois! En as-tu capturé un?

msgid: Whew… I better take a rest…\nGroan…\pThat tunnel from CERULEAN takes a\nlot out of you!
msgstr: Pfou… Je vais faire une halte.\nMoouarf…\pCe tunnel venant d’Azuria\nest épuisant!

msgid: Hey!\nI saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!
msgstr: Hé! On s’est déjà vus dans la\nForêt de Jade!

msgid: You beat me again!
msgstr: Ben, tu m’as encore battu!

msgid: There are other kinds of POKéMON\nthan the ones you find in forests.
msgstr: Il y a beaucoup de Pokémon\ndifférents dans la forêt!

msgid: Hi!\nI like shorts!\pThey're delightfully comfy and\neasy to wear!
msgstr: Yahaa!\nJ’adore les shorts! Viens t’battre!

msgid: I don't believe it!
msgstr: Nyahaa, tu m’as taillé un short!

msgid: Are you using a POKéMON CENTER's\nPC for storing your POKéMON?\pEach BOX can hold up to\n30 POKéMON.
msgstr: Pour ranger tes Pokémon,\nutilise un PC.\pChaque boîte contient 30 Pokémon!

msgid: Excuse me!\nYou looked at me, didn't you?
msgstr: Tu veux ma photo?

msgid: You're mean!
msgstr: Tiens, c’est ma photo!

msgid: You shouldn't be staring if you\ndon't want to battle!
msgstr: Baisse les yeux si tu veux éviter\nla baston!

msgid: Are you a TRAINER?\nLet's get with it right away!
msgstr: T’es un Dresseur?\nA l’attaque!

msgid: If I had new POKéMON, I would've\nwon!
msgstr: Avec d’autres Pokémon,\nj’aurais gagné!

msgid: If a POKéMON BOX on the PC gets\nfull, just switch to another BOX.
msgstr: Quand l’une des boîtes de ton PC\nest pleine, active une autre boîte!

msgid: That look you gave me…\nIt's so intriguing!
msgstr: Ce regard que tu m’as lancé…\nC’est plutôt intrigant.

msgid: Be nice!
msgstr: Hmmm… Sois plus sympa!

msgid: You can avoid battles by not\nletting TRAINERS see you.
msgstr: Evite les regards si tu ne veux\npas combattre!

msgid: Hey! You're not wearing shorts!\nWhat's wrong with you?
msgstr: Hé! T’as pas de short!\nTu crains!

msgid: Lost!\nLost! Lost!
msgstr: Perdu!\nPerdu, et perdu!

msgid: I always wear shorts, even in\nwinter. That's my policy.
msgstr: Je porte toujours des shorts, même\nen hiver!

msgid: I'll battle you with the POKéMON\nI just caught.
msgstr: Fais gaffe à mes nouveaux\nPokémon!

msgid: Done like dinner!
msgstr: Ben, y m’en faut des nouveaux!

msgid: Trained POKéMON are stronger than\nthe wild ones.
msgstr: Les Pokémon dressés sont plus\nforts que les Pokémon sauvages!

msgid: Eek!\nDid you touch me?
msgstr: Hé!\nTu m’as poussée là?

msgid: ROUTE 4 is at the foot of\nMT. MOON.
msgstr: La Route 4 est au pied du Mont\nSélénite.

msgid: ROUTE 3\nMT. MOON AHEAD
msgstr: Route 3\nMont Sélénite Droit Devant

msgid: Ouch! I tripped over a rocky\nPOKéMON, GEODUDE!
msgstr: Ha! J’ai trébuché sur un Pokémon\nRoche: RACAILLOU!

msgid: I came to MT. MOON in search of\nmushroom POKéMON.
msgstr: Je viens chercher mon Pokémon\nchampignon!

msgid: After all I did to catch them!
msgstr: Oh! Mon Pokémon!

msgid: There might not be any more\nmushrooms here.\pI think I got them all.
msgstr: Je crois qu’il n’y a plus de\nchampignons dans le coin.\pJe les ai tous ramassés.

msgid: A punch of roaring ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen the chips are down,\nMEGA PUNCH is the ultimate attack!\lYou agree, yes?\pNow!\nLet me teach it to your POKéMON!
msgstr:
Un coup de poing féroce d’une
puissance destructrice!\pEn cas de besoin, Ultimapoing
est l’attaque idéale, tu crois pas?\pBon, laisse-moi apprendre
Ultimapoing à un de tes Pokémon!

msgid: You'll be back when you understand\nthe worth of MEGA PUNCH.
msgstr: Tu reviendras quand tu auras\ncompris l’intérêt d’Ultimapoing.

msgid: Fine!\nWhich POKéMON will learn it?
msgstr: Parfait!\nQuel Pokémon doit l’apprendre?

msgid: Now, we are comrades in the way of\npunching!\pYou should go before you're seen\nby the misguided fool who trains\lonly his silly kicking over there.
msgstr: Nous sommes maintenant frères\ndans l’art du combat!\pTu devrais partir avant de tomber\nsur l’imbécile qui s’entraîne\pqu’en utilisant les coups de pied.

msgid: A kick of brutal ferocity!\pPacked with destructive power!\pWhen you get right down to it,\nMEGA KICK is the ultimate attack!\lDon't you agree?\pOkay!\nI'll teach it to your POKéMON!
msgstr:
Un coup de pied féroce d’une
grande puissance destructrice!\pEn cas de besoin, Ultimawashi
est l’attaque idéale, tu crois pas?\pBon, laisse-moi apprendre
Ultimawashi à un de tes Pokémon!

msgid: You'll come crawling back when you\nrealize the value of MEGA KICK.
msgstr: Tu reviendras vite quand tu auras\ncompris l’utilité d’Ultimawashi.

msgid: All right!\nWhich POKéMON wants to learn it?
msgstr: Très bien!\nQuel Pokémon doit l’apprendre?

msgid: Now, we are soul mates in the way\nof kicking!\pYou should run before you're seen\nby the deluded nitwit who trains\lonly simple punching over there.
msgstr:
Nous partageons maintenant la
même philosophie du combat.\pTu devrais t’en aller avant de
tomber sur l’imbécile qui ne\ps’entraîne qu’en utilisant les
coups de poing.

msgid:
Oh, wow, that's the BOULDERBADGE!
You got it from BROCK, didn't you?\pBROCK is cool. He's not just tough.
People like and respect him.\pI want to become a GYM LEADER
like him.
msgstr:
Oh, c’est le Badge Roche!
C’est Pierre qui te l’a donné, non?\pIl est cool. Il est très fort,
les gens l’aiment et le respectent.\pJe voudrais devenir Champion
d’Arène comme lui.

msgid: Okay, set six POKé BALLS in my\nbelt…\pYeah, that'll do it. At most, you\ncan have six POKéMON with you.
msgstr: J’ai 6 Poké Balls à ma ceinture.\pOn ne peut transporter que 6\nPokémon.

msgid: TEAM ROCKET attacks CERULEAN\ncitizens…\pNot a day goes by without TEAM\nROCKET being in the news.
msgstr: La Team Rocket a encore attaqué\nles habitants d’Azuria…\pPas une journée sans qu’on\nparle d’eux.

msgid: MAN: Hello there, laddie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?
msgstr: Bonjour l’ami! J’ai une super\naffaire à te proposer!\pJe t’offre un MAGICARPE pour\njuste 500¥! Qu’en dis-tu?

msgid: MAN: Hello there, sweetie pie!\nHave I got a deal just for you!\pI'll let you have a secret POKéMON\n- a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!\pSo, you'll buy it, am I right?
msgstr: Bonjour l’amie! J’ai une super\naffaire à te proposer!\pJe t’offre un MAGICARPE pour\njuste 500¥! Qu’en dis-tu?

msgid: {PLAYER} paid an outrageous ¥500\nand bought the MAGIKARP…
msgstr: {PLAYER} se fait avoir et achète\nle MAGICARPE…

msgid: No? You say no? I'm only doing this\nas a favor to you!
msgstr: Non? Allez!\nC’est un service que j’te rends!

msgid: There's no more room for any more\nPOKéMON, it looks like.
msgstr: Plus de place pour un Pokémon!

msgid: MAN: Well, I don't give refunds.\nYou knew what you were getting!
msgstr: Ni repris, ni échangé!

msgid: Sometimes, you'll have too many\nPOKéMON with you to add any more.\pIn that case, you should just\nstore some using any PC.
msgstr: Tu devrais ranger tes Pokémon en\ntrop en utilisant un PC!

msgid: I run the DAY-CARE service.\pWould you like me to raise one of\nyour POKéMON?
msgstr: Je m’occupe de la Pension.\pVeux-tu que j’élève un de tes\nPokémon?

msgid: Fine.\nCome anytime you like.
msgstr: Je vois.\nReviens me voir.

msgid: Fine, I'll look after your\n{STR_VAR_1} for a while.
msgstr: Très bien, je vais m’occuper de\n{STR_VAR_1}.

msgid: Come see me in a while.
msgstr: Reviens un peu plus tard.

msgid: You're back already?\pYour {STR_VAR_1} needs to spend\nsome more time with me.
msgstr: Déjà de retour?\pTon {STR_VAR_1} doit rester encore\nun peu.

msgid: You owe me ¥{STR_VAR_2} for the return\nof this POKéMON.
msgstr: Donne-moi {STR_VAR_2}¥ pour que\nje te rende ton Pokémon.

msgid: Thank you!\nHere's your POKéMON.
msgstr: Merci!\nVoilà ton p’tit Pokémon!

msgid: {PLAYER} got {STR_VAR_1} back\nfrom the DAY-CARE MAN.
msgstr: {PLAYER} récupère\n{STR_VAR_1}!

msgid: Oh? You only have one POKéMON\nwith you.
msgstr: Oh!\nTu n’as qu’un Pokémon sur toi.
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Oh, oh…\nVous n’avez qu’un Pokémon avec vous.

msgid: If you leave me that POKéMON,\nwhat will you battle with?
msgstr: Si tu me le laisses, avec quoi\nvas-tu pouvoir combattre?
detail: ancien [Émeraude FR officiel (adapté)] Si tu me laisses ce Pokémon, avec quoi\nvas-tu te battre?

msgid: Your {STR_VAR_1} has grown a lot.\nYes, quite a lot, I'd say.\pLet me see…\nBy level, it's grown by {STR_VAR_2}.\pAren't I great?
msgstr: Ton {STR_VAR_1} a bien grandi!\pIl a {STR_VAR_2} niveau(x)\nde plus!\pMerci qui? Hein?

msgid: You can't take this POKéMON back\nif you've got no room for it.
msgstr: Tu n’as plus de place pour ce\nPokémon!

msgid: I'm on guard duty.\nGee, I'm thirsty, though!\pOh, wait there, the road's closed.
msgstr: Je suis de garde ici…\nJe crève de soif!\pOh, la route est fermée.\nOn ne passe pas!

msgid: Oh, that TEA…\nIt looks awfully tasty…
msgstr: Oh, ce Thé…\nIl a l’air délicieux…

msgid: Huh? I can have this drink?\nGee, thanks!\l… …\lGlug, glug…\l… …\lGulp…\lIf you want to go to SAFFRON\lCITY…\l… …\lYou can go on through.\pI'll share this TEA with the other\nguards!
msgstr:
Hein? Tu veux bien m’en donner?
Super, merci!\p… …
Gloup, gloup… …\pTu peux passer si tu veux
aller à Safrania.\pJe vais partager ce Thé avec les
autres gardes!

msgid: Hi, how's it going?
msgstr: Salut! Comment ça va?

msgid: Who's there?\nQuit listening in on us!
msgstr: Qui est là?\nArrête de nous espionner!

msgid: I just can't win!
msgstr: … J’suis nul!

msgid: Whisper…\nWhisper…
msgstr: Soupirs…\nGros soupirs…

msgid: Excuse me!\nThis is a private conversation!
msgstr: Heu, c’est une conversation privée,\nDEGAGE!

msgid: Ugh!\nI hate losing.
msgstr: Non!\nJe déteste perdre!

msgid: There aren't many bugs out here.
msgstr: C’est plein d’insectes, ici.

msgid: No!\nYou're kidding!
msgstr: Non!\nC’est une blague!

msgid: I like bugs, so I'm going back to\nVIRIDIAN FOREST.
msgstr: Les insectes j’aime ça, je\nretourne dans la Forêt de Jade.

msgid: Huh?\nYou want to talk to me?
msgstr: Hein?\nTu veux me causer?

msgid: This stinks…\nI couldn't beat your challenge…
msgstr: …\nJ’ai rien fait!

msgid: I should bring more POKéMON with\nme. I'll feel safer that way.
msgstr: Il me faut plus de Pokémon pour\nme protéger.

msgid: Me?\nWell, okay. I'll play!
msgstr: Qui ça? Moi?\nOK. Attaque!

msgid: Things just didn't work…
msgstr: Oh! J’avais pas prévu ça!

msgid: I want to get stronger.\nWhat's your secret?
msgstr: Je veux être forte! Comme toi!\nC’est quoi ton secret?

msgid: I've never seen you around.\nAre you good?
msgstr: J’t’ai jamais vu dans le coin!\nT’es balèze?

msgid: You're too good!
msgstr: Whaa! Trop puissant!

msgid: Are my POKéMON weak?\nOr, am I just bad?\lWhich do you think?
msgstr: Mes Pokémon sont nuls ou je suis\ntrès mauvais?

msgid: You look good at POKéMON, but how\nis your chemistry grade?
msgstr: T’es habile avec tes Pokémon.\nMais les maths, tu connais?

msgid: Ow!\nMeltdown!
msgstr: Ouch!\nMauvais calcul.

msgid: I am better at school than this!
msgstr: Je suis meilleur à l’école!

msgid: All right!\nLet's play a game!
msgstr: Le sort en est jeté!

msgid: Drat!\nCame up short!
msgstr: Haaa!\nLe hasard…

msgid: Things didn't work today.
msgstr: Dame chance n’est pas avec moi!

msgid: You should be informed.\nYou need strategy to win at this!
msgstr: Il te faut une bonne stratégie!

msgid: It's not logical!
msgstr: Hé! Pas logique!

msgid: Go with GRIMER first…and…\n…and…then…
msgstr: D’abord TADMORV, et après…\nEt puis…

msgid: I like NIDORAN, so I collect them!
msgstr: Moi, j’aime les Nidoran! Yaha!

msgid: Why?\nWhy??
msgstr: Hein?

msgid: When POKéMON grow up, they get\nugly! They shouldn't evolve.
msgstr: Quand un Pokémon grandit,\nil devient gros et moche.\pJe les préfère tout petits!

msgid: School is fun, but so are POKéMON.
msgstr: L’école c’est cool, comme les Pokémon!

msgid: You made it clear to me that\nI should stick with school.
msgstr: Ben…\nL’école c’est plus facile!

msgid: I was planning on getting some\nfresh air for a change, but…\pWe're stuck here because of the\ngates at SAFFRON.
msgstr: On est bloqués ici, aux portes de\nSafrania.

msgid: MEOWTH is so cute, meow, meow,\nmeow!
msgstr: MIAOUSS est si mignon. Miaou!

msgid: Meeeeyow!
msgstr: Miaou!

msgid: I think PIDGEY and RATTATA are\ncute, too!
msgstr: Je trouve que ROUCOOL et RATTATA\nsont trop cool!

msgid: We must look silly standing here\nlike this.
msgstr: Je sais, on a l’air idiot à rester\ndebout comme ça!

msgid: Look what you did to my poor, cute\nPOKéMON!
msgstr: Ben…\nC’est malin ça!

msgid: SAFFRON's gatekeeper won't let us\ngo through.\pI know he's doing his job, but I\nthink he's mean.
msgstr: Le gardien de Safrania ne nous\nlaissera pas passer!\pJe sais que c’est son boulot, mais\nje ne l’aime pas beaucoup.

msgid: I'm a rambling, gaming dude!
msgstr: Je suis un joueur errant!

msgid: Missed the big chance!
msgstr: J’ai raté le jackpot!

msgid: Playing games and POKéMON are like\neating peanuts! I just can't stop!
msgstr: Le jeu et les Pokémon, c’est comme\nles cacahuètes. \pTu commences et tu peux plus\nt’arrêter! C’est fou!

msgid: What's a cute, round, and fluffy\nPOKéMON?
msgstr: Qu’il est mimi, gentil et trognon\nce Pokémon! Il est à qui?\lHein? A qui?

msgid: Stop!\pDon't be so mean to my CLEFAIRY!
msgstr: Arrête!\pT’es pas gentil avec MELOFEE!

msgid: I read that CLEFAIRY evolves when\nit's exposed to a MOON STONE.\pI read that in a POKéMON JOURNAL.\nI wonder if it's true?
msgstr: Il paraît que MELOFEE peut\névoluer grâce à une Pierre Lune.\pJ’ai lu ça quelque part, je me\ndemande si c’est vrai.

msgid: ELI: Twin power is fantastic.\nDid you know?
msgstr: Eli: La puissance des jumeaux est\nfantastique, tu le savais pas?

msgid: ELI: But…\nWe used our twin power…
msgstr: Eli: Mais…\nOn a utilisé notre puissance…

msgid: ELI: I caught my POKéMON with\nANNE!
msgstr: Eli: J’ai attrapé mes Pokémon\navec Anne.

msgid: ELI: We can't battle if you don't\nhave two POKéMON.
msgstr: Eli: On ne pourra pas se battre\nensemble si tu n’as qu’un Pokémon.

msgid: ANNE: We'll shock you with our twin\npower!
msgstr: Anne: On va te montrer notre\npuissance!

msgid: ANNE: I'm raising POKéMON with\nELI.
msgstr: Anne: Je dresse mes Pokémon\navec Eli.

msgid: ANNE: Hi, hi! Let's battle!\nBut bring two POKéMON.
msgstr: Anne: Hi, hi. Si tu veux combattre,\nil te faut deux Pokémon.

msgid: My bike's acting up, man.
msgstr: Je ne crains personne sur ma bécane.

msgid: Aww, man.\nI'm not into this.
msgstr: Aaah, non!\nJ’suis à sec.

msgid: I got grass caught up in my\nspokes, man.
msgstr: Le terrain était mauvais pour moi.

msgid: Clear the way, or I'll run you\ndown!
msgstr: Pousse-toi de là, ou je te\nroule dessus.

msgid: You for real, kid?
msgstr: Tu rigoles pas toi…

msgid: Don't think you're all special and\nall just because of this.
msgstr: Ne prends pas la grosse tête\njuste pour ça…

msgid: You have POKéMON with you!\nYou're mine!
msgstr: T’as des Pokémon avec toi!\nEn garde!

msgid: You deceived me…
msgstr: Ah! Bien défendu!

msgid: The tunnel coming up is pitch-black\ninside.\pYou'll need FLASH to get through\nthere.
msgstr: On n’y voit rien du tout dans ce\ntunnel.\pIl te faudrait Flash pour le\ntraverser.

msgid: Who's that walking there with those\ngood-looking POKéMON?
msgstr: Mais qui voilà, les bras chargés de\nPokémon?

msgid: Out like a light!
msgstr: Paf! J’suis fini!

msgid: I'm taking the ROCK TUNNEL to\ngo to LAVENDER…
msgstr: Je passe par la Grotte pour\naller à Lavanville!

msgid: Can't measure up…
msgstr: … J’suis pas bon!

msgid: Are you off to ROCK TUNNEL, too?
msgstr: Tu vas dans la Grotte, toi aussi?

msgid: Don't you dare patronize me!
msgstr: Traite-moi avec respect!

msgid: No!\nYou're too much.
msgstr: …\nJe ne mérite que ton dédain!
detail: ancien [Émeraude FR officiel (adapté)] Non!\nT’es vraiment trop!

msgid: You're obviously talented.\nGood luck to you!
msgstr: Tu iras loin!\nBonne chance à toi!

msgid: Bwahaha!\nGreat! I was bored, eh!
msgstr: Bwahaha! Allez…\nViens prendre ta pâtée…

msgid: Keep it coming, eh!\pOh wait.\nI'm out of POKéMON!
msgstr: Ha!\nViens, viens!\pHeu, j’ai plus de Pokémon!

msgid: You sure had guts standing up to\nme there, eh?
msgstr: T’as du courage, toi!

msgid: Hahaha!\nAren't you a little toughie!
msgstr: Hahaha!\nT’as l’air coriace, toi!

msgid: What's that?
msgstr: Dur, très dur!
detail: remplace [relu et corrigé à la main (le patch FR actuel donnait un morceau]

msgid: Hahaha!\nKids should be tough!
msgstr: Les gosses, c’est pas assez fort!

msgid: I got up early every day to raise\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!
msgstr: Mes cocons de Pokémon me\nprennent beaucoup de temps!

msgid: WHAT?\pWhat a total waste of time!
msgstr: Nyargh?\pQuelle perte de temps!

msgid: I have to collect more than bugs\nto get stronger…
msgstr: Il me faut autre chose que\ndes insectes pour être plus fort…

msgid: Hahahaha!\nBring it on!
msgstr: Viens t’battre, si tu oses!

msgid: Hahahaha!\nYou beat me fair!
msgstr: Ha!\nTu m’as bien eu!

msgid: Hahahaha!\nUs hearty guys always laugh!
msgstr: Hahahaha!\nQuand j’perds, j’me marre!

msgid: Go, my super BUG POKéMON!
msgstr: En avant mes Pokémon Insecte!

msgid: My bugs…
msgstr: Mes Pokémon!

msgid: If you don't like BUG POKéMON,\nyou bug me!
msgstr: T’aimes pas les Pokémon Insecte?\nT’es pas chouette!

msgid:
Bonjour!
I am le waiter on this ship!\pI will be happy to serve you
anything you please!\p… … …
Ah! Le strong silent type!
msgstr:
Bonjour! Je suis serveur sur ce
bateau!\pJe me ferai une joie de vous
servir!\pHa!
L’air du grand large!

msgid: The passengers are restless from\nthis long voyage.\pYou might be challenged by the\nmore bored ones!
msgstr: Les passagers sont en ébullition!\pIls vont certainement vous\nprovoquer en duel!

msgid: Ssh…!\nI'm a GLOBAL POLICE agent.\pI'm on the trail of TEAM ROCKET.\nThey're up to nothing good!
msgstr: Psst!\nJe suis de l’Interpolice!\pJe suis sur la trace de la\nTeam Rocket! Chut!

msgid: I love POKéMON!\nDo you?
msgstr: J’aime les Pokémon! Et toi?

msgid: Wow! \nYou're great!
msgstr: Woo!\nT’es cool, toi!

msgid: Listen, listen!\nLet me be your friend, okay?\pThen we can trade POKéMON and\ndo stuff.
msgstr: Soyons amis, OK?\pComme ça, on pourra\néchanger nos Pokémon!

msgid: I collected these POKéMON\nfrom all around the world!
msgstr: J’ai déniché ces Pokémon un peu\npartout dans le monde!

msgid: Oh, no!\nI went around the world for these!
msgstr: Quoi! Un tour du monde pour ce\nrésultat! C’est nul!

msgid: You hurt my poor POKéMON!\pI demand that you heal them at a\nPOKéMON CENTER!
msgstr: Tu as fait mal à mes Pokémon!\pIl faut que tu les soignes dans un\nCentre Pokémon!!!

msgid: We are cruising around the world,\nmy children and I.
msgstr: Nous parcourons les mers du\nmonde entier!

msgid: A world cruise is so elegant yet\ncozy!
msgstr: Ha! Une croisière!\nC’est tellement romantique!

msgid: I always travel with WIGGLYTUFF.\nI never leave home without it.
msgstr: Je voyage toujours avec\nGRODOUDOU!

msgid: WIGGLYTUFF: Puup pupuu!
msgstr: GRODOUDOU: Gro! Douuuuuuu!

msgid: Waiter, I would like a cherry pie,\nplease!
msgstr: C’est le service de chambre?\nAmenez-moi une tarte aux poires!

msgid: Waitress, I would like a cherry\npie, please!
msgstr: Mademoiselle? Je voudrais une\ntarte, et plus vite que ça!

msgid: You insolent pup!\nHow dare you barge in!
msgstr: Toi, t’as du culot!\nTu oses entrer ici!?

msgid: Humph! You rude child!\nYou have no sense of courtesy!
msgstr: Huf!\nAucun sens de la courtoisie!!

msgid: I wish to be left alone!\nGet out!
msgstr: J’aimerais être seul!\nVa-t-en!

msgid: You look tired. Would you like to\ntake a short rest?
msgstr: Tu as fait un long voyage, non?\nTu veux te reposer un moment?

msgid: I'm glad to see that everyone is\nlooking refreshed and chipper.
msgstr: Contente de voir que tout le\nmonde va bien.

msgid: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little brother…
msgstr: Oh, désolée de t’embêter. Mais tu\nressembles à mon petit frère.

msgid: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.\nYou look like my little sister…
msgstr: Oh, désolée de t’embêter. Mais tu\nressembles à ma petite sœur.

msgid: I am but a solitary traveler…\pMy sole companions and friends are\nPOKéMON I caught on my journeys…
msgstr: Je voyage toujours en solitaire!\pMes Pokémon sont mes amis!

msgid: My, my friends…
msgstr: Non! Mes p’tits amis!

msgid: You should be nice to friends!
msgstr: Il faut être gentil avec ses Pokémon!

msgid: This ship, she is a luxury liner for\nTRAINERS of the world!\pAt every port, we hold parties with\ninvited TRAINERS.
msgstr: Ce luxueux bateau accueille tous\nles Dresseurs!\pDans chaque port, nous organisons\nune fête pour les Dresseurs!

msgid:
{RIVAL}: Bonjour!
{PLAYER}!\pImagine seeing you here!
{PLAYER}, were you really invited?\pSo how's your POKéDEX coming?\pI already caught 40 kinds, pal.
Different kinds are everywhere.\pCrawl around in grassy areas, and
look hard for them.
msgstr:
{RIVAL}: Salut, {PLAYER}!\pToi! Ici! Sans blague!
{PLAYER}, tu as reçu une invitation?\pOù en es-tu avec ton Pokédex?\pMoi, j’ai déjà attrapé 40 Pokémon!
Et ils sont de différents types.\pY’en a partout! Tu n’as qu’à ramper
dans les hautes herbes!

msgid: Humph!\pAt least you're raising your\nPOKéMON!
msgstr: Mouaff!\pAu moins, tu t’occupes de tes\nPokémon!

msgid:
{RIVAL}: I heard there was a CUT
master on board.\pBut he was just a seasick old man!\pCUT itself is really useful.
Yup, it'll be handy.\pYou should go see him, too.
Smell ya!
msgstr:
{RIVAL}: Il y a le maître de la
capacité Coupe à bord.\pMais ce n’est qu’un vieil homme
malade et sénile!\pLa capacité Coupe est très
utile!\pTu devrais le rencontrer!
Allez, salut!

msgid: I've journeyed far and wide, but in\nall my travels I've never seen\lany POKéMON sleep like this one!\pIt was something like this!
msgstr: De tous mes voyages, je n’ai\njamais vu un Pokémon dormir\lautant!\pIl était un peu comme ça…

msgid: Competing against the young keeps\nme youthful.
msgstr: Les duels contre les jeunes me\nmaintiennent en forme!

msgid: Good match!\nAh, I feel young again!
msgstr: Woah!\nHa! Je me sens en pleine forme!

msgid: Fifteen years ago, I would\nhave won!
msgstr: Hmm!\nIl y a 15 ans, j’aurais gagné…

msgid: Check out what I fished up!
msgstr: Hé! Regarde ce que j’ai pêché!

msgid: I'm all out!
msgstr: OK! J’suis fait!!

msgid: Party?\pThe cruise ship's party should be\nover by now.
msgstr: Une fête?\pElle doit être finie maintenant.

msgid: Ah, yes, I have seen some POKéMON\nferry people across the water!
msgstr: Tiens! J’ai vu des Pokémon\ntransporter des gens sur l’eau!

msgid:
Small trees can be chopped down
using the move CUT.\pBut remember this!
CUT is an HM technique.\pOnce learned, it is not so easily
discarded.
msgstr:
Les Pokémon peuvent couper des
petits buissons avec Coupe.\pMais n’oublie pas! Coupe est
une CS.\pUne fois apprise, on ne peut pas
facilement l’oublier.

msgid: Which do you find more worthy,\na strong or a rare POKéMON?
msgstr: Qu’est-ce que tu préfères?\nUn Pokémon costaud ou rare?

msgid: I must salute you!
msgstr: Bravo! Tu es plutôt balèze!

msgid: Personally, I prefer strong and\nrare POKéMON.
msgstr: Je préfère les Pokémon rares\net costauds!

msgid: I don't believe I saw you at the\nparty?
msgstr: Je ne crois pas que tu étais \nà la fête.

msgid: Oh, I adore your strong POKéMON!\nOh, how I envy you for them!
msgstr: Woah! Tes Pokémon sont super\nforts! Je les adore!

msgid: Have you gone to the SAFARI ZONE\nin FUCHSIA CITY?\pThere are many kinds of rare\nPOKéMON.
msgstr: As-tu déjà vu le Parc Safari\nà Parmanie?\pOn y trouve plein de Pokémon\nrares!

msgid: Me and my daddy think the SAFARI\nZONE is awesome!\lI wish we could go there again.
msgstr: Mon pôpa et moi, on pense que le\nParc Safari il est génial!

msgid: The CAPTAIN said he's awfully sick.\nHe was all pale.
msgstr: Le Capitaine avait l’air tout\npâlot!

msgid: I hear many people get seasick.
msgstr: C’est assez fréquent d’avoir le mal\nde mer!

msgid: Our CAPTAIN is a sword master.\nHe's awesome at using CUT.\pThey say he even teaches CUT\nto POKéMON!
msgstr: Notre Capitaine est un maître\nd’armes! Il utilise souvent Coupe.\pIl enseigne à ses Pokémon la\ncapacité Coupe!

msgid: Matey, you're walking the plank if\nyou lose!
msgstr: Si tu perds, on te balance aux\nrequins!

msgid: Argh!\nBeaten by a kid!
msgstr: Hein?\nBattu par toi?

msgid: When we're out at sea, jellyfish\nPOKéMON sometimes drift by.
msgstr: Quelques Pokémon sont souvent\nentraînés dans le sillage du\lbateau…

msgid: Hello, stranger!\pI can't tell if you're from the seas\nor mountains, but stop and chat.\pAll my POKéMON are from the sea.
msgstr: Salut étranger!\nParlons un peu!\pTous mes Pokémon viennent\nde la mer!

msgid: Darn!\nI let that one get away!
msgstr: Zut!\nCelui-là s’est échappé!

msgid: I was going to make you my\nassistant, too!
msgstr: Je cherche un assistant. Tu aurais\npu faire l’affaire.

msgid: Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!
msgstr: Nous, les marins, on a aussi des\nPokémon!

msgid: Okay, you're not bad.
msgstr: OK! Tu te bats pas trop mal!

msgid: We caught all our POKéMON while\nwe were out at sea.
msgstr: Tous nos Pokémon viennent des\nhautes mers!

msgid: I like feisty kids like you!
msgstr: J’aime les enfants joyeux comme toi!

msgid: Argh!\nLost it!
msgstr: Hein?\nJ’ai perdu? Argh!

msgid: Sea POKéMON live in deep water.\nYou'll need a ROD to fish them up!
msgstr: Les Pokémon Eau vivent dans les\ngrands fonds! J’ai besoin d’une\lCanne!

msgid: You know what they say about\nsailors and battling!
msgstr: Tu sais ce qu’on raconte sur les\nmarins et les duels!

msgid: Right!\nGood battle, mate!
msgstr: Ouaip!\nBeau combat!

msgid: Hahaha!\nWant to be a sailor, mate?
msgstr: Alors, mousse, tu veux devenir\nmarin?

msgid: Come on, then!\nMy sailor's pride is at stake!
msgstr: Ma réputation de marin est en jeu!

msgid: Your spirit sank me!
msgstr: Ha! Je sombre!

msgid: Did you see the FISHING GURU in\nVERMILION CITY?
msgstr: As-tu rencontré le Maître Pêcheur\nà Carmin sur Mer?

msgid: My buddy MACHOKE is super strong!\pHe has enough STRENGTH to move\nbig rocks!
msgstr: Mon Pokémon, MACHOPEUR,\nest super fort!!!\pSa Force lui permet de bouger\nles rochers!

msgid: MACHOKE: Gwoh! Goggoh!
msgstr: MACHOPEUR: Chop! Chop! Chop!

msgid: CAPTAIN: Ooargh…\nI feel hideous…\lUrrp! Seasick…
msgstr: Capitaine: Blorf.\nJ’suis pas bien.\lBeurp…

msgid: {PLAYER} rubbed the CAPTAIN's\nback!\pRub-rub…\nRub-rub…
msgstr: {PLAYER} tape dans le dos\ndu Capitaine!\pTap tap…\nTap tap…

msgid:
CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you!
I'm feeling much better now.\pYou want to see my hidden CUT
technique?\pI could show you my prized CUT
technique if I weren't so ill…\pI know! You can have this!
This HIDDEN MACHINE!\pTeach CUT to your POKéMON, and
you can see it CUT anytime!
msgstr:
Capitaine: Merci moussaillon!
Ça va beaucoup mieux…\pMille sabords! Tu veux voir la
capacité Coupe?\pJe pourrais te la montrer, mais
j’suis malade.\pJe sais! Prends ça!
C’est une Capsule Secrète!\pElle contient la capacité Coupe.
Enseigne-la à tes Pokémon\ppour l’utiliser quand tu veux!

msgid: {PLAYER} obtained HM01\nfrom the CAPTAIN!
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient\nCS01!

msgid: Using CUT, you can chop down\nsmall trees.\pWhy not try it with the trees\naround VERMILION CITY?
msgstr: Avec Coupe, tu peux abattre\nles petits arbres.\pTu devrais essayer sur les arbres\nprès de Carmin sur Mer.

msgid: CAPTAIN: …Whew!\pNow that I'm not sick anymore,\nI guess it's time.\pThe S.S. ANNE will set sail soon!\pFarewell, until our return to\nVERMILION CITY!
msgstr: Capitaine: Haaaa!\pMaintenant que je suis guéri, on va\nlever l’ancre!\pL’Océane va bientôt partir!\pBon vent! Nous reviendrons\nbientôt à Carmin sur Mer!

msgid: Oh, no!\nYou have no room for this!
msgstr: Ha zut! Tu n’as plus de place pour\ncet objet!

msgid: How to Conquer Seasickness…\nThe CAPTAIN's reading this!
msgstr: Comment guérir le mal de mer…\nLe Capitaine lit le manuel!

msgid: The party's over.\nThe ship will be departing soon.
msgstr: La fête est finie! Nous allons\nbientôt lever l’ancre!

msgid: Whew!\nScrubbing decks is hard work!
msgstr: Nyah! Briquer le pont, c’est un\ntravail épuisant!

msgid: Urf… I feel ill…\pI got seasick, so I stepped out to\nget some air…
msgstr: Gueuh! J’suis malaaaaade…\pJe vais bientôt vom…

msgid: Hey, matey!\pLet's do a little jig!
msgstr: Hé! Toi, là!\pTu danses?\nUn tango?

msgid: You're impressive!
msgstr: … Belle technique!

msgid: How many kinds of POKéMON do you\nthink there are in this big world?
msgstr: Tu sais combien il y a de Pokémon\ndifférents? Hein, tu l’sais, hein?

msgid: Ahoy, there!\nAre you seasick?
msgstr: Hoï!\nT’as le mal de mer?

msgid: I was just careless!
msgstr: Oh! Beau combat!

msgid: My pa said there are 100 kinds of\nPOKéMON. I think there are more.
msgstr: Mon pôpa, y dit qu’y a 100 Pokémon\ndifférents. J’suis sûr qu’y en a\lplus…

msgid: You, mon petit!\nWe're busy here!\lOut of the way!
msgstr: Hé! Toi là! Y’en a qui bossent\ndur ici! Alors dégage!

msgid: I saw an odd BERRY in the trash.\nI wonder what that was?
msgstr: Y’avait une Baie bizarre dans la\npoubelle. Tu sais ce que c’est?

msgid: I'm so busy I'm getting dizzy!\nYou have to give me room here!
msgstr: J’ai trop de boulot! J’en ai \ndes vertiges!

msgid: Hum-de-hum-de-ho…\pI peel spuds every day!\nHum-hum…
msgstr: Pourquoi?\nPourquoi moi?\pJ’suis tout l’temps d’corvée\nd’patates…

msgid: Did you hear about SNORLAX?\nIt's a glutton.\pNo other POKéMON eats and sleeps\nthe way SNORLAX can and does!
msgstr: Tu connais RONFLEX?\pIl passe ses journées à manger\net à dormir!

msgid: Snivel… Sniff…\pI only get to peel onions…\nSnivel…
msgstr: Sniff…\n… sniff…\pJ’épluche des oignons…

msgid: Er-hem!\nIndeed I am le CHEF!\pLe main course is
msgstr: Hm, hm!\nJe suis le chef cuistot!\pVoilà le menu:

msgid: Salmon du Salad!\pLes guests may gripe it's fish\nagain, however!
msgstr: Salade de saumon!\pPour ceux qui ne sont pas contents\nc’est la même chose!

msgid: Eels au Barbecue!\pLes guests will mutiny, I fear.
msgstr: Pâté d’anguilles!\pDe quoi donner des envies de\nmutinerie!

msgid: Prime Beefsteak!\pBut, have I enough fillets du\nbeef?
msgstr: Côtes de bœuf!\pMais je crois que je n’ai plus de\nviande?!

msgid: REST HOUSE
msgstr: Abri
detail: remplace [relu et corrigé à la main (le patch FR actuel donnait un morceau]

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pPress START to check\nremaining time.
msgstr: Astuce\pAppuyez sur Start pour consulter\nle chronomètre!

msgid: CENTER AREA
msgstr: Parc Central

msgid: SARA: Where did my boyfriend,\nERIK, go?
msgstr: Julia: Où est Nico, mon petit ami?

msgid: I'm catching POKéMON to take home\nas gifts.
msgstr: Je capture des Pokémon pour\nles offrir!

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pThe remaining time declines only\nwhile you walk.
msgstr: Astuce\pLe temps s’écoule en fonction\ndes pas!

msgid: AREA 1\nWEST: CENTER AREA
msgstr: Parc 1\nOuest: Parc Central

msgid: How many did you catch?\nI'm bushed from the effort!
msgstr: T’en as capturé combien? Moi j’suis\nnaze!

msgid: I caught a CHANSEY!\pThat makes this all worthwhile.
msgstr: J’ai trouvé un LEVEINARD!\pJ’ai bien fait de chercher pendant\n4 heures!

msgid: Whew!\nI'm tired from all the fun!
msgstr: Pffff!\nJ’en ai marre!

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pThe SECRET HOUSE is still ahead.
msgstr: Astuce\pLa Cabane Secrète est tout droit!

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pPOKéMON hide in tall grass.\pZigzag through grassy areas to\nflush them out.
msgstr: Astuce\pLes Pokémon se cachent dans les\nhautes herbes!\pExplorez ces zones pour les faire\nsortir.

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pWin a free HM for finding the\nSECRET HOUSE.
msgstr: Astuce\pDécouvrez la Cabane Secrète et\ngagnez une CS!

msgid: You can keep any item you find in\nthe SAFARI ZONE.\pBut, you'll run out of time if you\ntry for all of them at once.
msgstr: Tu peux garder tous les objets\ntrouvés dans le coin.\pMais ne perds pas de temps à tous\nles essayer!

msgid: Go to the deepest part of the\nSAFARI ZONE. You will win a prize!
msgstr: Le coin le plus reculé du Parc\nSafari cache un prix spécial!

msgid: My EEVEE evolved into FLAREON.\pBut, a friend's EEVEE turned into a\nVAPOREON. I wonder why?
msgstr: Mon EVOLI s’est transformé en\nPYROLI!\pMais celui d’un ami s’est changé\nen AQUALI! Bah pourquoi?

msgid:
Ah! Finally!\pYou're the first person to reach
the SECRET HOUSE!\pAlthough I made a campaign
for our grand opening,\pI was getting worried that no one
would win our campaign prize.\pCongratulations!
You have won!
msgstr:
Ah! Quand même!\pEnfin quelqu’un qui découvre
la Cabane Secrète!\pJ’avais peur que personne ne
gagne notre prix.\pFélicitations!
Tu as gagné!

msgid: {PLAYER} received HM03\nfrom the attendant!
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient la CS03\nde l’intendant!

msgid:
HM03 is SURF.\pPOKéMON will be able to ferry you
across water using it.\pAnd, this HM isn't disposable, so
you can use it over and over.\pYou're super lucky for winning this
fabulous prize!
msgstr: CS03 contient Surf!\pUn Pokémon pourra te faire\nnaviguer sur les flots!\pEn plus, cette CS peut s’utiliser à\nl’infini!\pT’en as de la chance!

msgid: You don't have room for this\nfabulous prize!
msgstr: Heu… Tu n’as pas assez de place\npour recevoir ce prix fabuleux!

msgid: REQUEST NOTICE\pPlease find the SAFARI WARDEN's\nlost GOLD TEETH.\lThey're around here somewhere.\pReward offered!\nContact: WARDEN
msgstr: Avis\pVeuillez trouver la Dent d’Or du\nGardien. Explorez les environs.\pRécompense assurée!\nContactez le Gardien.

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pZone Exploration Campaign!\nThe Search for the SECRET HOUSE!
msgstr: Astuce\pGrand concours organisé:\nCherchez la Cabane Secrète!

msgid: AREA 3\nEAST: CENTER AREA
msgstr: Parc 3\nest: Parc Central

msgid:
The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say?\pFUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often.\pThanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.
msgstr:
Le Parc Safari est immense,
tu trouves pas?\pKoga, le Champion d’Arène de
Parmanie vient souvent ici.\pGrâce à lui, on peut se promener
en sécurité.

msgid: Tossing ROCKS at POKéMON might\nmake them run, but they'll be\leasier to catch.
msgstr: Une Pierre peut faire fuir les\nPokémon mais ils seront plus\lfaciles à capturer.

msgid: Using BAIT will make POKéMON more\nlikely to stick around if they get\lbusy eating.
msgstr: Un Appât peut faciliter vos\ncaptures.

msgid: I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any\nPOKéMON I wanted.
msgstr: J’ai cherché toute la sainte\njournée mais j’ai rien capturé.

msgid: My daughter is so self-centered.\nShe has but a few friends.
msgstr: Ma fille est très égocentrique!\nElle n’a pas beaucoup d’amis.

msgid: My daughter likes to mimic people.\nIt's rather vexing.\pHer mimicry has earned her the\nnickname COPYCAT around here.
msgstr: Ma fille adore imiter les gens.\pElle imite si bien qu’on l’appelle\nla Copieuse dans le coin!
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Pour notre malheur, notre fille aime\nimiter les gens. C’est assez agaçant.\pA force d’imiter, elle a gagné le\nsurnom de Copieuse dans le quartier.

msgid:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Do you like POKéMON?\p{PLAYER}: Uh, no, I just asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Huh?
You're strange!\pCOPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?
But, that's my favorite hobby!
msgstr:
{PLAYER}: Salut!
Tu aimes les Pokémon?\p{PLAYER}: Heu, non
Je demandais juste!\p{PLAYER}: Hein?
T’es bizarre toi!\pCopieuse: Hmm?
Arrêter de mimer?\pMais je ne sais faire que ça!
detail:
ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] {PLAYER}: Salut!
Tu aimes les Pokémon?\p{PLAYER}: Non, pas moi, toi!\p{PLAYER}: Hé!
T’es trop bizarre!\pCopieuse: Hmm? Arrêter de copier?
Mais c’est mon passe-temps préféré!

msgid:
{PLAYER}: Hi.
You must like POKéMON.\p{PLAYER}: No, not me.
I asked you.\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?
You're weird!\l \lCOPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking?\lBut that's my favorite hobby!
msgstr:
{PLAYER}: Salut! Tu dois aimer
les Pokémon, non?\p{PLAYER}: Heu, non
Je demandais juste!\p{PLAYER}: Hein?
T’es bizarre toi!\pCopieuse: Hmm?
Arrêter de mimer?\pMais je ne sais faire que ça!

msgid:
Oh wow!
A POKé DOLL!\pFor me?
Thank you!\pYou know what?
I can teach the move MIMIC.
msgstr: Whaaaaaa!\nUne Poképoupée!\pC’est pour moi?\nMerci!\pTiens, prends ça en échange!

msgid: Don't you like MIMIC?
msgstr: T’aimes pas Copie?

msgid: I really love MIMIC!\nWho's going to learn it?
msgstr: Moi aussi j’adore! Alors, qui\nva l’apprendre?

msgid:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks for earlier!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it that fun to mimic my
every move?\pCOPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!
msgstr:
{PLAYER}: Salut!
Merci pour la CT31!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Heu…
C’est aussi cool que ça de\lm’imiter?\pCopieuse: Ah non! C’est vraiment la
galère, t’arrêtes pas d’bouger!
detail:
ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] {PLAYER}: Salut! Merci pour tout à
l’heure!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: C’est si amusant que ça de
copier tout ce que je fais?\pPhotocopie: Et comment! C’est trop
drôle!

msgid:
{PLAYER}: Hi!
Thanks for what you did for us.\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Is it really that fun to
copy what I say and do?\pCOPYCAT: You bet!
It's a scream!
msgstr:
{PLAYER}: Salut!
Merci pour la CT31!\p{PLAYER}: Pardon?\p{PLAYER}: Heu…
C’est aussi marrant que ça de\lm’imiter?\pCopieuse: Ah non! C’est vraiment la
galère, t’arrêtes pas d’bouger!

msgid: DODUO: Giiih!\pPRETTY MIRROR LOOK AT ME,\nSEE HOW PRETTY I CAN BE?
msgstr: DODUO: Doduuu!\pJoli Miroir, dis-moi qui est\nla plus belle!

msgid: This is a rare POKéMON!\nHuh? It's only a doll!
msgstr: Ça, un Pokémon rare? Tu t’moques\nde moi! C’est rien qu’une poupée!

msgid: A game with MARIO wearing a bucket\non his head!
msgstr: Un plombier? Mais…\nÇa a l’air sympa.

msgid: …\pMy Secrets!\pSkill: Mimicry!\nHobby: Collecting dolls!\lFavorite POKéMON: CLEFAIRY!
msgstr: …\pMes secrets!\pMon boulot: je mime!\nMa passion: les poupées!\lMon Pokémon préféré: MELOFEE!

msgid: Grunt!\pI am the KARATE MASTER!\nI am the LEADER here!\pYou wish to challenge us?\nExpect no mercy!\pFwaaa!
msgstr:
Jeune Dresseur!\pJe suis le Grand Maître de
Karaté! Je suis le Champion!\pTu me provoques?
Tu veux m’affronter?\pJe n’aurai aucune pitié!
HAHAHA! Ayaaaaa!

msgid: Hwa!\nArrgh! Beaten!
msgstr: STOP!\nTu m’as battu! J’ai honte!

msgid: Indeed, I have lost!\pBut, I beseech you, do not take\nour emblem as your trophy!\pIn return, I will give you a prized\nFIGHTING POKéMON!\pChoose whichever one you like!
msgstr: OK, tu as gagné!\pMais ne va pas le crier sur tous\nles toits! Tu sais te battre, on a\lcompris!\pTiens, prends ça!\nTu as gagné un Pokémon Combat!\pChoisis celui que tu veux!

msgid: Grunt!\nStay and train at karate with us!
msgstr: Reste avec nous pour faire du\nKaraté!

msgid: Hoargh!\nTake your shoes off!
msgstr: Roooh!\nEnlève tes chaussures!

msgid: You wait 'til you see our MASTER!\nI'm a small fry compared to him!
msgstr: Tu te tais, tu t’assois et tu\nattends le grand maître!\pTu vas comprendre ta douleur!\nIl est invincible.

msgid: I hear you're good!\nShow me!
msgstr: T’as des prétentions?\nMontre-moi!

msgid: Judge!\nOne point!
msgstr: Un point pour toi!

msgid: Our MASTER is a pro fighter.\nBe prepared to lose!
msgstr: Notre maître est un pro.\nPrépare-toi à perdre!

msgid: Hiyah!\nI have no fear for anything tough!\pI shatter boulders for training\nevery day!
msgstr: J’ai peur de rien!\pLe matin, j’casse des pierres\npour m’entraîner!

msgid: Yow!\nStubbed fingers!
msgstr: Woaa! Les pierres, ça rend pas\nles coups!

msgid: The only thing that frightens us is\npsychic power!
msgstr: La seule chose qui nous fait peur\nc’est les pouvoirs psy!

msgid: Hwaah!\pYou're trespassing in our\nFIGHTING DOJO!
msgstr: Ayah!\pTu joues avec ta vie!\nCe Dojo, c’est pour les balèzes!

msgid: Oof!\nI give up!
msgstr: Ouille!\nJ’suis KO!

msgid: The prime fighters across the land\ntrain here.
msgstr: Les meilleurs combattants\ndu pays sont ici!

msgid: You want the hard-kicking\nHITMONLEE?
msgstr: Tu veux KICKLEE, l’expert\nen coups de pied?

msgid: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1}\nfrom the KARATE MASTER.
msgstr: {PLAYER} reçoit un\n{STR_VAR_1}!

msgid: You want the piston-punching\nHITMONCHAN?
msgstr: Tu veux TYGNON, le puncheur?

msgid: Better not get greedy…
msgstr: Tss tss tss!\nFaut pas être trop gourmand…

msgid: Enemies on every side!
msgstr: Ne compte que sur toi!

msgid: What goes around comes around.
msgstr: Respecte ton ennemi!

msgid: FIGHTING DOJO
msgstr: Dojo

msgid: What do you want?\nGet lost!
msgstr: Kess tu veux?\nDu vent!

msgid: BOSS said he'll take this town\nin the name of TEAM ROCKET!
msgstr: Le Chef dit qu’il contrôlera\ncette ville!

msgid: Don't get defiant!\nOr I'll have to hurt you!
msgstr: Bouge de là!

msgid: SAFFRON belongs to TEAM ROCKET!
msgstr: Safrania appartient à la Team Rocket!

msgid: My life as a criminal makes me feel\nso alive!
msgstr: Rien de mieux qu’une vie de\ncriminel pour se sentir vivant!

msgid: Ow!\nWatch where you're walking!
msgstr: Tu m’as marché sur le pied,\nnon?

msgid: With SILPH under control, we can\nexploit POKéMON around the world!\pWe'll get stinking rich, yeahah!
msgstr: Avec la Sylphe dans notre poche,\nles Pokémon du monde entier\pseront à nous! On va être\nsuper riches.

msgid: You beat TEAM ROCKET all alone?\nThat's amazing!
msgstr: Tu as vraiment battu la Team\nRocket? Incroyable!

msgid: Yeah! TEAM ROCKET is gone!\nIt's safe to go out again!
msgstr: Ouais! La Team est partie!\nOn peut enfin respirer!

msgid: People fled from here in droves\nwhen those ROCKETS came.\pThey should be flocking back to\nSAFFRON now.
msgstr: Tout le monde va vite revenir à\nSafrania maintenant que\pla Team Rocket est partie.

msgid: I flew here on my PIDGEOT when\nI read about SILPH.\pIt's already over?\nI missed the media action…
msgstr: Je suis venu ici en volant sur mon\nROUCARNAGE après avoir lu les\pnouvelles de la Sylphe.\pTout est déjà fini?\nJ’ai tout loupé?

msgid: PIDGEOT: Bi bibii!
msgstr: ROUCARNAGE: Rou!

msgid: I saw the ROCKET BOSS escaping\nSILPH's building.
msgstr: J’ai vu le Chef de la Team Rocket\ns’enfuir de la Sylphe.

msgid: I'm a security guard.\pSuspicious kids I don't allow in!
msgstr: Moi…\nJ’suis un garde.\pLes nabots tout louches, moi,\nj’les laisse pas passer!

msgid: …\nSnore…\pHah! He's taking a snooze!
msgstr: …\n(ronffl)…\pAh! Il dort!

msgid: SAFFRON CITY\nShining, Golden Land of Commerce
msgstr: Safrania\nLà où le commerce est roi
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Safrania\nLe berceau doré du commerce

msgid: SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\lThe Master of PSYCHIC POKéMON!
msgstr: Arène Pokémon de Safrania \nChampion: Morgane\lMaîtresse des Pokémon Psy!
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Arène de Safrania Championne:\nMorgane La maîtresse des Pokémon\lPsy!

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pFULL HEAL cures all ailments like\nburns, paralysis, poisoning,\lfreezing, and sleep.\pIt costs a bit more, but it's more\nconvenient than buying other items.
msgstr:
Astuce\pTotal Soin fait disparaître tous
les changements de statut\pcomme sommeil, brûlure,
paralysie ou gel par exemple.\pC’est un peu cher mais ça vaut
le coup.

msgid: TRAINER TIPS\pThe new GREAT BALL offers improved\ncatching rates.\pTry it on those hard-to-catch\nPOKéMON.
msgstr: Astuce\pLa Super Ball augmente les\nchances de capture.\pFaites un essai sur des Pokémon\ndifficiles à attraper.

msgid: SILPH's latest product!\nRelease to be determined…
msgstr: Dernier produit de la Sylphe!\pLa date de sortie est encore à\ndéterminer…
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Le petit dernier de la Sylphe SARL!\nDate de sortie à déterminer…

msgid: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\pMany TRAINERS have scribbled their\nnames on this sign.
msgstr: Fan Club des Dresseurs Pokémon\pDes noms de Dresseurs sont\ninscrits sur le panneau…

msgid:
This FAN CLUB…
No one here has a clue!\pHow could they not recognize
the brilliance that is LANCE?\pHe stands for justice!
He's cool, and yet passionate!\lHe's the greatest, LANCE!
msgstr:
Ce Fan Club…
Personne n’a une petite idée?\pComment ne peuvent-ils pas
reconnaître le génie de Peter?\pIl défend la justice!
Il est posé et pourtant passionné!\lC’est le plus grand, c’est Peter!

msgid:
I had a vision of your arrival.\pI have had psychic powers since
I was a child.\pIt started when a spoon I
carelessly tossed, bent.\pI dislike battling, but if you wish,
I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
msgstr:
J’avais prédit ton arrivée!\pJ’ai des pouvoirs psychiques depuis
l’enfance.\pJ’ai appris à plier des cuillères
par la force de l’esprit. C’est\lpas super utile, mais ça en jette!\pJe n’aime pas les combats, mais si
tu insistes, je vais te montrer mes\lpouvoirs!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}

msgid:
This loss shocks me!
But, a loss is a loss.\pI admit, I didn't work hard enough
to win.\pYour victory has earned you the
MARSHBADGE.
msgstr: Ha! Je suis surprise!\nTu as gagné.\pC’est vrai, je n’ai pas fait de mon\nmieux! Tu mérites ta victoire!\pTu gagnes le Badge Marais!

msgid: Psychic power isn't something that\nonly a few people have.\pEveryone has psychic power.\nPeople just don't realize it.
msgstr: Tout le monde est un peu médium!\nIl faut juste travailler ses dons!

msgid:
The MARSHBADGE makes POKéMON up
to Lv. 70 obey you.\pStronger POKéMON will become wild,
ignoring your orders in battle.\pJust don't raise your POKéMON too
much to avoid that problem.\pWait, please take this TM with you.
msgstr:
Avec le Badge Marais, les Pokémon
de niveau 70 t’obéiront!\pLes Pokémon plus puissants seront
incontrôlables lors des combats!\pFais en sorte que tes Pokémon ne
dépassent pas cette limite!\pTiens! Prends ça aussi!

msgid: {PLAYER} received TM04 from\nSABRINA.
msgstr: {PLAYER} reçoit la CT04\nde Morgane.

msgid: TM04 is CALM MIND.\pIt makes the POKéMON concentrate\nto raise both SP. ATK and SP. DEF.
msgstr: C’est Plénitude.\pAvec cette capacité, les Pokémon\nse concentrent et augmentent leur\pAtq. Spé. et leur Déf. Spé.

msgid: SABRINA is far younger than I,\nbut she has earned my respect.
msgstr: Morgane est une petite parvenue!\nMais je l’aime bien!

msgid: In a battle of equals, the one\nwith the stronger will wins.\pIf you wish to beat SABRINA, focus\nand will yourself to victory.
msgstr: Dans une baston, ce qui est\nimportant, c’est la volonté de\lgagner!\pSi tu veux gagner face à Morgane,\nconcentre-toi sur la victoire!

msgid: Does our unseen power scare you?
msgstr: Nos pouvoirs occultes te font peur?

msgid: I never foresaw this!
msgstr: Nyan! T’as pas l’air effrayé!

msgid: PSYCHIC POKéMON fear only ghosts\nand bugs!
msgstr: Les Pokémon Psy craignent les\nInsectes et les Spectres!

msgid: POKéMON take on the appearance of\ntheir TRAINERS.\pYour POKéMON must be tough, then!
msgstr: L’aura du maître déteint sur ses\nPokémon.\pTes Pokémon doivent être\nforts alors!

msgid: I have much to learn still…\pI must master PSYCHIC and teach it\nto my POKéMON…
msgstr: J’ai encore beaucoup à apprendre…\pJe dois maîtriser Psyko et\nl’enseigner à mes Pokémon.

msgid: You understand, don't you?\pThat power alone isn't enough to\nwin in the world of POKéMON?
msgstr: Tu comprends hein?\pLa puissance seule sans la\nmaîtrise ne sert à rien!

msgid: I don't believe this!
msgstr: Huh! J’appelle pas ça rien!

msgid: SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.
msgstr: Morgane a pulvérisé le grand\nMaître de Karaté!
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Le Maître Karaté du Dojo d’à côté\nvient de se faire retourner comme\lune crêpe par Morgane.

msgid: You and I, our POKéMON shall\nbattle!
msgstr: Toi… Moi… Nos Pokémon…\nFIGHT!

msgid: I lost after all!
msgstr: Puff! J’ai perdu!

msgid: I knew that this was going to take\nplace.
msgstr: J’avais prévu ce qui s’est passé.

msgid: SABRINA is young, but she's also\nour highly skilled LEADER.\pYou won't reach her easily!
msgstr: Morgane est jeune mais c’est\naussi notre Champion!\pTu vas en baver avant\nde l’atteindre!

msgid: Ow!\nDown and out!
msgstr: Oups!\nJ’ai rien capté!
detail: ancien [Émeraude FR officiel (adapté)] Aïe!\nA terre et hors combat!

msgid:
There used to be two POKéMON GYMS
in SAFFRON.\pThe FIGHTING DOJO next door lost
its GYM status, though.\pWe simply creamed them when we
decided to have just one GYM.
msgstr:
Il y avait deux Arènes Pokémon à
Safrania.\pLe Dojo Karaté a perdu son titre
d’Arène le jour où nous l’avons\lpulvérisé!\pIl ne pouvait pas y avoir deux
Arènes ici.

msgid: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM is famous for\ntraining psychics.\pYou want to see SABRINA, don't\nyou? I can tell!
msgstr: Le Champion de l’Arène Pokémon\nde Safrania est une médium psy!\pTu veux voir Morgane, hein?\nJe lis tes pensées, ne mens pas!

msgid: That's right! I used telepathy to\nread your mind!
msgstr: J’ai lu dans ton esprit! C’est pas\ntrès clair dedans!

msgid:
Yo!
Champ in the making!\pSABRINA's POKéMON use psychic
power instead of force.\pFIGHTING POKéMON are especially
weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.\pThey'll get destroyed before they
can even aim a punch!
msgstr:
Salut!
Graine de Champion!\pLes Pokémon de Morgane sont
des Pokémon Psy!\pLes Pokémon Combat sont
désavantagés!\pIls deviennent dingues avant de
pouvoir porter un coup!

msgid: Psychic power, huh?\pIf I had that, I'd make a bundle\nat the slots!
msgstr: Pouvoirs psy? Hmmm…\nSi j’en avais, je gagnerais!

msgid: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}
msgstr: Arène Pokémon de Safrania\nChampion: Morgane\pVainqueurs:\n{RIVAL}

msgid: SAFFRON POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pWINNING TRAINERS:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
msgstr: Arène Pokémon de Safrania\nChampion: Morgane\pVainqueurs:\n{RIVAL}, {PLAYER}

msgid: …Thank you for writing.\nI hope to see you soon!\p…Hey!\nDon't look at my letter!
msgstr: Merci pour cette belle lettre, à\nbientôt!\pHé! R’garde pas c’que j’écris!\nJ’suis amoureuse!

msgid: PIDGEY: Kurukkoo!
msgstr: ROUCOOL: Rourou!

msgid: The COPYCAT is cute!\nI'm getting her a POKé DOLL.
msgstr: La Copieuse est mignonne! Je vais\nlui offrir une Poképoupée!

msgid: I was given a PP UP as a gift.\pIt's used to increase the PP of\na POKéMON's move.\pI should use it on a powerful move\nwith only a few PP.
msgstr:
J’ai reçu comme récompense
un PP Plus.\pIl sert à augmenter les PP d’une
attaque d’un Pokémon.\pJe devrais choisir une attaque
avec peu de PP.

msgid: MAX REPEL keeps weaker POKéMON\nfrom appearing.\pMAX REPEL stays effective longer\nthan SUPER REPEL.
msgstr: Le Max Repousse fonctionne plus\nlongtemps que le Superepousse!

msgid: REVIVE is costly, but it revives\nfainted POKéMON!
msgstr: Le Rappel est coûteux mais il\npeut réanimer un Pokémon KO!

msgid: …Wait! Don't say a word!\pYou wanted this!
msgstr: … Chut! Pas un mot!\pTu veux ça?
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] … Attends! Ne dis rien!\pTu veux ça!

msgid: {PLAYER} received TM29\nfrom MR. PSYCHIC.
msgstr: {PLAYER} obtient la\nCT29!

msgid: You already know, don't you?\nTM29 is PSYCHIC.\pIt's an attack that may also lower\nthe target's special stats.
msgstr: CT29: Psyko!\pCette attaque diminue le Spécial\nde la cible.
detail: ancien [SoulSilver FR officiel (adapté)] Tu le sais déjà, n’est-ce pas?\nLa CT29 contient Psyko.\pC’est une attaque qui peut aussi\nbaisser les stats spéciales de\ll’ennemi.

msgid: Where do you plan to put this?\nYou've no room.
msgstr: Ton inventaire est plein!

msgid: POKéMON growth rates differ from\nspecies to species.
msgstr: Les Pokémon grandissent\ndifféremment selon les espèces.

msgid: SILPH CO. is widely known to all.\pIt's a victim of its own fame - it\nattracted TEAM ROCKET.
msgstr: La Sylphe SARL est très connue.\pC’est pourquoi la Team Rocket l’a\ninvestie!

msgid: Sigh…\nWouldn't this be great?\pIf the ELITE FOUR came and\nstomped TEAM ROCKET?
msgstr: Pourquoi le Conseil 4 ne vient\npas chasser la Team Rocket?

msgid: TEAM ROCKET took off!\nWe can go out safely again!\lThat's great!
msgstr: La Team Rocket est partie!\nAlors c’est la fête! Youpi!

msgid: Huh?\nYou…
msgstr: Hein?\nC’est toi?…

msgid:
Are you maybe…
… …\pYou are!
You are {PLAYER}!\pWe were just talking about you!\pWe were talking about how an
incredibly good TRAINER appeared.\pAnd that someone is you!
You're so cool!\pSo, we decided that we'll become
your FAN CLUB!\pWe all hope you'll keep battling
and show us how cool you are.\pThat way, maybe other people will
become fans just like me.
msgstr:
Tu es peut-être…
… …\pTu es…
C’est toi, {PLAYER}!\pOn parlait justement de toi!\pOn parlait de ce nouveau Dresseur
super fort.\pEt cette personne c’est toi!
C’est trop fort!\pAlors on va créer ton Fan Club!\pEn continuant à te battre comme
ça, je suis sûre que tu vas\pavoir de plus en plus de fans!

msgid: I'll always be cheering for you!\pGo, {PLAYER}, go!
msgstr: Je te soutiendrai toujours!\pGo, {PLAYER}, go!

msgid: I'll always believe in you,\n{PLAYER}.\pPlease show the others what you're\nlike when you battle seriously.
msgstr: Je croirai toujours en toi,\n{PLAYER}.\pMontre aux autres ce que c’est\nun super Dresseur!

msgid:
I'm sorry.
I was your fan before.\pBut now, you seem to have lost
the drive you had before.\pLately, I think {STR_VAR_1} has been
a lot cooler.
msgstr:
Désolée.
J’étais une de tes fans avant.\pMais on dirait que t’as plus
l’énergie que t’avais avant.\pD’ailleurs, je trouve que {STR_VAR_1}
est carrément plus cool!

msgid:
Oh!
{PLAYER}!\pEveryone's been all excited about
you recently.\pI can understand why.
I know that you're strong.\pBut, do you know what?\pOnce I became {STR_VAR_1}'s fan,
I can't just stop being a fan.
msgstr:
Oh!
{PLAYER}!\pTout le monde parle de toi
en ce moment.\pJe vois très bien pourquoi!
C’est vrai que t’es fortiche.\pMais tu sais quoi?\pJ’suis aussi fan de {STR_VAR_1}!

msgid: I think TRAINERS are so cool when\nthey're battling.\pDon't you think so, too?
msgstr: Les Dresseurs sont siiiii cool\nquand ils se battent!\pTu crois pas?

msgid:
Oh! It's {PLAYER}!
Too cool!\pOh!
Oh, yeah!\pCan you autograph something?
How about my shorts?
msgstr: Oh! C’est {PLAYER}!\nTrop cool!\pJe peux avoir ton autographe?\nAllez, s’te plaît, sur mon short!

msgid:
However hot it's been…\pAnd however cold it may get…\pI've always believed in, and worn,
shorts!\pI'm counting on you to keep
winning!\pI believe in you just as much as
I believe in shorts!
msgstr: Qu’il fasse super chaud…\pOu qu’il fasse super froid…\pUne chose est sûre, je garderai\nmon short!\pAllez, continue de gagner, je crois\nen toi comme dans mes shorts!

msgid:
BROCK's my hero!
He's a man among men!\pHeheh, I got my mom to do
something for me.\pI got her to embroider “BROCK”
on my shorts!
msgstr: Pierre est mon héros!\nC’est un vrai mec!\pHehehe, t’as vu ça, ma mère\nm’a brodé le nom de Pierre\psur mon short. Trop classe!

msgid: …  …\p…  …\nI'm BROCK's fan!\pEven if I were his only fan,\nI swear it on my rock-hard will,\land on my shorts!\pI'll be his fan to the bitter end!
msgstr: … …\pJe suis fan de Pierre!\pEt je le resterai quoi qu’il\narrive!\pJ’le jure sur mon short!

msgid: BROCK's the last word on cool,\nend of story!\pNow there's a guy who I want to\nbe like!
msgstr: Pierre, c’est le plus cool,\npoint à la ligne!\pSi je lui ressemblais, j’aurais\ntrop de succès avec les filles.

msgid:
{PLAYER}, I've had the pleasure of
watching you battle.\pIt brings back sweet memories of
my own long-lost youth.\pMay you continue to find success.
You have a fan in me!
msgstr:
{PLAYER}, j’ai eu le plaisir de te
voir combattre.\pD’ailleurs, cela m’a rappelé les
grands moments de ma jeunesse.\pEn tout cas, sache que tu as tout
mon soutien.

msgid:
I have journeyed far and wide
across the lands.\pBut never have I seen a TRAINER
of your magnificence.\pTake courage in your abilities
and keep battling on!\pMake that a promise to me,
my young idol!
msgstr: J’ai voyagé par-delà les océans.\pMais jamais, je n’avais vu un\nDresseur comme toi.\pPrends conscience de ta force\net ne perds pas espoir!\pFais-moi cette promesse!

msgid: Hmm…\nAnd you are?\pWere you hoping to sign up for\na membership in our FAN CLUB?
msgstr: Hmm…\nEt tu es?\pTu comptais vraiment entrer\nau Fan Club?

msgid:
All of us gathered here are fans
of POKéMON TRAINERS.\pThe way they look in battle…
They are the picture of coolness.\pPerhaps you will be talked about
here, too, if you keep winning.
msgstr:
Nous sommes tous des fans
de Dresseurs Pokémon.\pRien de plus impressionnant qu’un
Dresseur en plein combat.\pQui sait, si tu continues comme
ça, le jour viendra peut-être\poù l’on parlera aussi de toi.

msgid: It's {PLAYER}!\nIt's {PLAYER}!\pI want to be like {PLAYER} one day!
msgstr: C’est {PLAYER}!\nC’est {PLAYER}!\pUn jour, je serai comme {PLAYER}!

msgid: Do you know what?\nI want to be like SABRINA!\pI want to be a psychic girl just\nlike her!
msgstr: T’sais quoi?\nJ’adorerais être comme Morgane!\pMais je vais devoir développer\nmes pouvoirs Psy pour ça.

msgid:
Even if I'm the only one, I won't
stop being SABRINA's fan.\pMy dream is to be like SABRINA,
cute, but cool.\pI want to be a psychic girl just
like her!
msgstr:
Même si je dois être la dernière,
je serai toujours fan de Morgane!\pMon rêve, c’est d’être aussi belle
